title: Legal Assistant
description:
Job Summary

This position is for a highly motivated and exceptionally organized Legal Assistant within a fast-paced legal environment. This hybrid role is essential to the success of our practice, providing a full range of support to attorneys in both pre-litigation and litigation phases.



The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong technical skills and a client-focused attitude. You will be responsible for a blend of paralegal and legal assistant duties, managing case files from inception through resolution.



Core Responsibilities

Administrative & Client Support

• Answer and screen incoming phone calls, acting as a professional first point of contact for clients, opposing counsel, and courts.

• Handle, process, and distribute all incoming/outgoing faxes and mail.

• Serve as a key point of contact for clients, providing non-legal status updates and gathering necessary information.

• Perform conflict checks for all potential new matters.

• Open new client matters and maintain physical and electronic files in accordance with firm standards.



Case Management & Development

• Maintain and meticulously update the firm's case management software with deadlines, contact information, case status, and notes.

• Manage and maintain attorney calendars, including scheduling appointments, calls, and critical case deadlines.

• Draft and send letters of representation to clients, opposing counsel, insurance carriers, and healthcare providers.

• Obtain, track, and follow up on all case-related records, including medical bills/reports, employment records, police reports, and insurance information.

• Draft detailed medical summaries and chronologies.

• Acknowledge and track liens from providers, insurers, and government agencies (e.g., Medicare/Medicaid).

• Assist attorneys with the preparation and assembly of settlement demand packages.



Litigation & Discovery

• Assist with drafting initial pleadings, including Summons, Complaints, and Answers.

• Coordinate service of process for summonses, complaints, and subpoenas.

• Draft outgoing discovery, including Form Interrogatories, Special Interrogatories, Requests for Production of Documents, and Requests for Admission.

• Prepare "skeletons" for discovery responses, coordinate the collection of responsive documents and information from the client, and prepare final responses.

• Organize and Bates stamp document productions (both incoming and outgoing).

• Review and analyze discovery responses from other parties, identifying deficiencies and assisting with "meet and confer" correspondence.

• Prepare and issue deposition and records subpoenas.

• Schedule depositions, mediations, and hearings, including coordinating with all parties, court reporters, and videographers.

• Prepare and serve Notices of Deposition (NODs) and other hearing notices.

• Set up and manage remote appearances (e.g., via Zoom or court-specific portals).

Motion, Trial, & Case Resolution

• Assist with drafting notices of motion and declarations; prepare and organize motion exhibits.

• Assist with trial preparation, including the creation of exhibit binders, witness lists, and trial binders.

• Coordinate and communicate with expert witnesses to schedule, obtain reports, and prepare expert designations.

• Prepare, serve, and electronically file various legal documents in state and federal courts (e.g., OneLegal, File&Serve, CM/ECF).

• Negotiate lien reductions with medical providers and insurers.

• Prepare and file CMS-related documents and declarations.

• Draft settlement agreements, releases, and Requests for Dismissal.

• Prepare final distributions/disbursement schedules and corresponding check letters for clients and providers.

• Handle all file-closing procedures, including archiving documents and returning original materials to the client.



Qualifications & Skills

• Experience: 3+ years of experience as a legal assistant or paralegal in a civil litigation environment. Experience in personal injury legal assistant work in California is a plus. 

• Education: Paralegal Certificate or equivalent combination of education and experience is a plus.

Technical Skills:

o High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel).

o Experience with case management software (e.g., PracticePanther, Clio, MyCase, ProLaw, etc.).

o Proficiency with PDF software (e.g., Adobe Acrobat) for Bates stamping, redacting, and exhibits.

o Experience with state and federal e-filing portals is required.

Core Competencies:

o Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

o Strong written and verbal communication skills.

o Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively under pressure.

o Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

o Understands and maintains strict confidentiality.

title: 12 HR Decision | VA Remote Virtual Receptionist
description:
Important: Our application process moves very quickly. If you are selected for the next rounds of interviews, you must be able to respond promptly. Candidates who do not respond in a timely manner may be passed over.



We are currently seeking a Remote Spa Receptionist. This role consists of handling inbound calls, booking appointments, and completing various administrative tasks. This is a long-term, performance-based position. All calls are recorded and reviewed regularly. Continued placement depends on accuracy, professionalism, booking success, reliable attendance, no missed calls during scheduled shifts, quick response times, and the ability to professionally manage complaints and de-escalate dissatisfied clients.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a voice-based role, we also offer non-voice positions with a heavier focus on administrative tasks, subject to availability and overall fit.



To apply: Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly.



(1) Location & Utilities: Where in the Philippines are you currently located? How often have you experienced power or internet outages in the past year? Do you have backup solutions (e.g., generator, mobile hotspot) to ensure your work is not affected?



(2) Home Setup: Will you be working from home? Is your workspace quiet and suitable for handling calls? Do you have your own computer or laptop? Please attach a screenshot of your current internet speed.



(3) Availability & Speed: Can you consistently work seven days a week, six hours per day, and remain available for the full shift without missed calls? How quickly do you typically answer inbound calls? What is your current typing speed in words per minute?



(4) Call & Complaint Experience: Describe your experience with answering inbound calls, booking or scheduling appointments, customer service, following scripts, and handling complaints. Provide one real example of how you de-escalated an upset client and the outcome.



(5) Tools & Systems: What programs, tools, phone systems, or VoIP platforms have you used for handling calls? Do you have any issues with background noise, power outages, or internet interruptions? How do you take notes and log client interactions during calls?



(6) Voice Recordings: Please submit two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund. Your tone should be calm, polite, and professional.



(7) Current Job: Do you currently have another job? If yes, where, how many hours per week, and what are your roles and tasks in that job?



(8) Schedule, Pay & Start Date: Are you able to work seven days a week, six hours per day, during Central Standard Time (CST) hours without conflicts? What is your expected hourly or monthly rate? What is your earliest physical start date if hired?



(9) Marketing, Design & Video: Do you have experience with online marketing, creating content using Canva, or producing short video clips such as
 Reels or similar platforms? Please describe your skills and provide samples of your previous work if available.



(10) Fit, Skills & Experience: Briefly introduce yourself and explain why you would be a good fit for this role. Include what you believe is most important when handling spa clients over the phone, especially during complaints, and what other skills or areas you have a lot of experience in.

title: Listing Management & Website Operations VA
description:
Position Title: Listing Management & Website Operations VA



Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

About AlphaX RE Capital

AlphaX RE Capital and its affiliated entities form a women-founded, integrated real estate firm based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Committed to creating innovative and sustainable housing solutions throughout California, our group manages an extensive and growing portfolio of assets and development projects. We are a leader in addressing the housing crisis by developing sustainable and affordable communities.

Taking a comprehensive approach, we oversee the complete real estate lifecycle from end to end. AlphaX emphasizes diversity, equity, and social impact, with initiatives such as the AlphaX Foundation and Small Builders Association empowering future leaders, women, and minorities in real estate. Our headquarters is located in Cupertino, CA, with additional offices in Southern California and Arizona.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant (VA) to manage property listings, ensure data accuracy, coordinate website updates, and support communication with our web development team.

This role plays a critical part in keeping our listings accurate, our website up to date, and our internal processes running efficiently. The ideal candidate is proactive, tech-savvy, comfortable working with large datasets, and able to communicate clearly with both internal teams and external developers.

Key Responsibilities

1. Listing Management Oversight

-  Monitor and maintain active property records in the Listing Management Sheet 

-  Review and update listing statuses (Active, Pending, Sold, Off-Market) 

-  Verify pricing, availability, and builder notes for accuracy 

-  Identify inconsistencies, missing data, or outdated information 

-  Maintain a daily/weekly log of updates and issues 

2. Elevation Rendering Review

-  Review new elevation renderings provided by builders/architects 

-  Match renderings to the correct plans, models, and unit numbers 

-  Identify discrepancies between renderings and listing data 

-  Prepare notes for website updates or developer adjustments 

3. Website Content Updates (AL Homes Website)

-  Upload new renderings, floor plans, and listing details 

-  Update pricing, availability, and property descriptions 

-  Ensure images are optimized, correctly labeled, and properly displayed 

-  Perform quality checks on desktop and mobile after updates 

-  Maintain a change log for internal tracking 

4. Developer Coordination

-  Document bugs, layout issues, or incorrect data display 

-  Prepare clear developer tickets with screenshots, URLs, and expected behavior 

-  Communicate with the web developer as needed to resolve issues 

-  Track open items through to completion 

5. Data Cleanup & Quality Control

-  Identify and remove duplicate entries in the Listing Management Sheet 

-  Standardize formatting, naming conventions, and data structure 

-  Ensure all properties have unique identifiers 

-  Maintain a clean, organized, and version-controlled master sheet 

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications:

-  Strong experience with Google Sheets / Excel (filters, deduplication, data validation) 

-  Ability to manage large datasets with accuracy and consistency 

-  Experience with website CMS platforms (WordPress, custom CMS, or similar) 

-  Basic understanding of image handling (resizing, labeling, uploading) 

-  Excellent written communication skills 

-  Strong attention to detail and ability to spot inconsistencies 

-  Ability to work independently and meet deadlines 



Why Join AlphaX?

- Shape Our Strategic Growth: AlphaX is in a pivotal phase of expansion. This is a defining opportunity to partner with our leadership to scale the organization, influence our corporate trajectory, and build a lasting industry legacy.

- Accelerated Professional Advancement: Our entrepreneurial, high-performance environment rewards driven professionals with substantial career progression and unparalleled exposure to the complete real estate lifecycle.

- Mission-Driven Execution: Collaborate with a deeply passionate, high-caliber team dedicated to executing complex, innovative strategies that actively solve California’s housing challenges.

- Forward-Thinking Strategy: Operate in a highly dynamic environment. Backed by an expanding portfolio of assets, we move decisively to capitalize on market opportunities and encourage innovative solutions to traditional real estate challenges.



Benefits

The expected salary range for this position is $650-$700 per month. The actual salary offer will be determined based on the successful candidate's geographic location, relevant experience, and specific skill sets, in accordance with California laws.



AlphaX RE Capital and its affiliates are Equal Opportunity Employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees in accordance with the California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA). All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

title: Medical Claims Billing Specialist (RCM)
description:
About Sailor Health

At Sailor Health, we envision a world where every senior has seamless access to compassionate, effective, and personalized mental health care. Join us on our mission to redefine the golden years, enabling older adults across the nation to live happier, healthier, and more fulfilling lives.



About the Role

Title: Medical Claims Billing Specialist

Location: Remote – Philippines only

Monthly pay rate: USD $1,200–$1,500 (full-time; no other jobs allowed. Compensation within the range will be determined based on experience.)



We’re hiring a full-time remote Medical Claims Billing Specialist to support Sailor Health’s growing Revenue Cycle Management operations. This is a highly execution-driven role focused on ensuring claims are submitted accurately, worked quickly, and reimbursed efficiently.



You will spend the majority of your day submitting medical claims, following up with insurance payers, resolving denials, correcting claim issues, and ensuring timely payment across Medicare and commercial insurance plans. Your work will directly impact the financial health of the company and help ensure patients can continue accessing care without interruption.



This role sits at the intersection of operations, billing, and payer management. It is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, persistent, and experienced in U.S. healthcare billing workflows.



Experience in all of the following is absolutely mandatory:

-Medical claims billing

-Revenue cycle management (RCM)

-Insurance claims follow-up and denials management

-Prior experience working in U.S. healthcare 



Responsibilities

-Submit medical claims accurately and efficiently to insurance payers

-Review, track, and follow up on denied, rejected, unpaid, or stale claims

-Work directly with insurance companies to resolve billing and reimbursement issues

-Identify and resolve claim errors, eligibility issues, authorization gaps, and payer rejections

-Submit corrected claims and manage appeals when necessary

-Maintain accurate documentation and claim status updates across internal systems

-Monitor aging claims and proactively escalate high-risk accounts or payer issues

-Partner closely with intake, credentialing, clinical, and operations teams to resolve claim blockers quickly

-Ensure timely and accurate workflows related to reimbursement and collections

The common thread is always the same: automation tools, developer dashboards, API integrations, and keeping complex systems running cleanly across whatever Alletta is building.



If you thrive in a fast-moving, AI-driven environment where no two weeks are identical, this role is for you.



We don't hire people to do what machines can do. We hire people to run the machines.



????????????????????????????????????



THE ROLE



You are the Tech Operations Specialist for the Alletta portfolio. You keep the automated infrastructure running across all active ventures — current ones and new ones as they launch. You onboard new projects into the operational pipeline and handle the setup, configuration, and ongoing monitoring work that keeps everything moving.



Alletta is always building. That means your work evolves continuously. One month, you are setting up YouTube channels and submitting affiliate applications. The next time you are configuring a new SaaS product dashboard or managing API credentials for a newsletter platform. The venture changes. The skill set stays the same.



This is not a content creation role. This is not traditional social media management. This is systems operations for someone who is comfortable with APIs, developer dashboards, and automation tools across any platform — and who takes genuine satisfaction in a complex machine running smoothly.



????????????????????????????????????



YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS — EXACTLY WHAT YOU WILL DO



We believe in total transparency about what this role looks like from day one. Here is your first month precisely.



WEEK 1 — YOUTUBE NETWORK SETUP

• Create 21 Google Workspace user accounts for the YouTube channel network using admin access provided

• Set up each YouTube channel under its corresponding Workspace account

• Complete YouTube channel verification for custom thumbnails on each channel

• Record all channel IDs and configuration details in Airtable

• Coordinate with our deployment engineer to provide channel credentials for OAuth setup

• Load affiliate placeholder URLs into Airtable for all 21 channels using our prepared reference list



WEEK 2 — AFFILIATE PROGRAM APPLICATIONS

• Submit all Tier 1 affiliate program applications across all channels using our prepared Affiliate Pack — network description, standard answers, and full program list all provided — no research required

• Track all submissions in the Affiliate Tracker — date submitted, status, notes — in real time

• Follow up on any programs requesting additional information

• Update Airtable with real tracking links as approvals arrive

• Begin Tier 2 submissions by the end of the week



WEEK 3 —
 
 
-BUILD CHECKLIST

• Work through the complete
 
 
-build checklist — provided in full detail on day one

• Create 
 Pages under Meta Business Manager using admin access provided

• Retrieve Meta Graph API tokens for each page

• Complete all required tool signups and API credential gathering on the checklist

• Register for
-specific affiliate programs

• Deliver a complete build-ready package to the founder confirming every checklist item is done — this triggers the
 pipeline build day



WEEK 4 — OPERATIONS RHYTHM BEGINS

• Both networks are moving toward live status

• Pipeline monitoring begins as systems come online

• Weekly ops summary introduced — what ran, what was flagged, what was fixed

• Affiliate approval tracking continues as programs respond

• Alert response protocols activated



By the end of Month 1, you will have set up a 21-channel YouTube network, submitted 70+ affiliate applications, and fully prepared a 20-page
 network for automated pipeline deployment — all from written instructions and provided access credentials.



????????????????????????????????????



ONGOING RESPONSIBILITIES (from Month 2)



WEEKLY (approximately 4–6 hours/week):

• Content pipeline review across
 and YouTube networks via 
 dashboard

• System health monitoring — 
 pages, 21 YouTube channels, and growing

• Affiliate link verification across all active pages and channels

• Alert response when automated monitoring detects pipeline issues



MONTHLY:

• Affiliate revenue reconciliation across all programs

• System configuration updates as directed

• Monthly ops summary to the founder



PROJECT ONBOARDING (as new ventures launch):

• Account creation and API credential setup for new platforms and tools

• Integration of new ventures into the existing automation pipeline



????????????????????????????????????



TOOLS AND PLATFORMS YOU WILL WORK IN



Core infrastructure (used daily or weekly):

• Airtable — content and operations database

• 
 — automation pipeline monitoring

• Meta Business Suite + Meta Graph API —
 page management

• YouTube Studio + YouTube Data API — channel management

• Replug — affiliate link management

• ManyChat — automated comment management

• Slack — communication and alerts

• 1Password — credential management (non-negotiable)



Project-specific (varies by venture):

• Google Workspace (company account provided)

• Vercel / GitHub — dashboard monitoring

• Claude API dashboard — usage monitoring

• Various SaaS developer dashboards and affiliate portals



Training is provided on all tools. Prior experience with any of them is a strong advantage.



????????????????????????????????????



WHAT YOU WILL HAVE ACCESS TO



To do this job properly and without bottlenecks, you will have:



• A dedicated Alletta Google Workspace account

• Admin access to Alletta Meta Business Manager (to create and manage pages)

• Google Workspace admin access (to create and manage YouTube channel accounts)

• Access to a shared Alletta Operations drive with all SOPs, briefs, and credentials

• Direct Slack access to the founder for decisions that need escalation



This is an empowered operator role. The goal is for you to move projects forward independently without waiting for the founder to be in the middle of every small task.



????????????????????????????????????



HOURS AND GROWTH



Starting hours: approximately 25 hours per week

Starting pay: $10–$12/hour ($1,000–$1,200/month)



Note: Month 1 is intensive setup and will likely run 35–45 hours. From Month 2 onwards, the operational rhythm stabilises at approximately 25 hours per week.



Alletta operates multiple ventures simultaneously and launches new ones continuously. As each new venture comes online, your operational scope expands with it. The natural path for this role is full-time within 6–9 months and Operations Manager across the full Alletta portfolio within 12 months.



This is a long-term role inside a growing multi-venture company. If the idea of your work expanding into new industries and platforms every few months excites you, this role is for you. If you prefer a fixed task list that never changes, this role is not.



????????????????????????????????????



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



REQUIRED:

? Comfortable navigating unfamiliar developer dashboards and API consoles from written instructions — no coding required, but no panic when you see a terminal or JSON response

? Experience with
 Business Manager and/or YouTube Studio at a multi-account level

? Experience with any automation platform — 
, Zapier, n8n, or similar

? Experience retrieving and managing API credentials from any developer platform

? Strong attention to detail — you are the final human check before content publishes across 40+ channels

? Secure credential management — you must use a proper password manager (1Password, Bitwarden, or equivalent)

? Professional written English for affiliate program and vendor communications

? Proactive problem-solving — investigate first, escalate second



STRONG ADVANTAGE:

+ 
 experience specifically

+ Airtable database management

+ Meta Graph API or YouTube Data API familiarity

+ Affiliate network experience (Impact, CJ, ShareASale, Awin)

+ Multi-account social media management (10+ accounts simultaneously)

+ BPO, agency, or AI company background



NOT REQUIRED:

? Content creation or copywriting

? Graphic design or video editing

? Paid advertising management

? Software development or programming



????????????????????????????????????



WHAT WORKING AT ALLETTA LOOKS LIKE



• Fully remote, async-first — no fixed hours, no mandatory daily calls

• Clear written SOPs for every task — you always know exactly what to do

• Communication via Slack — response expected within 24 business hours

• Weekly check-in message from you summarising what ran, what was flagged, and what was fixed

• You will never be asked to do something without a clear brief or checklist

• You will regularly encounter new platforms and tools — this is expected and supported, not a surprise

• We pay on time, every time, via OnlineJobs.ph



????????????????????????????????????



HOW TO APPLY



We read every application carefully. We do not read generic cover letters.



Please answer all four of the following. Applications missing any answer will not be reviewed.



1. AUTOMATION EXPERIENCE

Describe the most complex automation workflow you have built or managed. What tools did you use? What did it connect? What broke and how did you fix it?



2. MULTI-ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT

How many
 Pages, YouTube Channels, or social media accounts have you managed simultaneously? What tools did you use to keep them organised?



3. CREDENTIAL SECURITY

What password manager do you use to store client credentials and API keys? How do you organise credentials across multiple clients or projects?



4. TEST TASK — REQUIRED

You receive a Slack alert at 9 am: "CRITICAL OUTAGE — network has gone silent for 24 hours." Walk me through your exact diagnostic steps using 
, Airtable, and the Meta Graph API. You have not seen our specific system before. Show me how you think — not what you know.



We are looking for structured thinking and calm problem-solving in Question 4. Make reasonable assumptions and show your diagnostic process. There is no single right answer.

title: Part-Time Customer Care Associate - US HVAC Company (Night Shift, $7/hr, Path to Full-Time)
description:
ABOUT US

We are Big Air Heat and A/C (
), a family-owned HVAC company in Fort Myers, Florida. We help homeowners with air conditioning repair, maintenance, and installation. We are growing fast and need one sharp, dependable person to be the friendly voice our customers hear on the phone.



THE ROLE

You will:

- Call our customers to confirm appointments and follow up on quotes

- Reply to text messages and chat conversations from leads and customers

- After 60-day trial: answer inbound customer calls through Housecall Pro

- Book new service appointments into our schedule

- Small office tasks: data entry, chasing Google reviews, light reporting



We will train you on everything Big Air-specific. We do not need HVAC experience. We need someone smart, warm on the phone, and reliable.



SHIFT

Monday-Friday, 4 hours/day during US Eastern Time business hours. That means you work either 8pm-12am OR 12am-4am Philippines time. You MUST be okay with permanent night shift.



PAY AND BENEFITS

Part-time trial (Months 1-2):

- $7/hour, 20 hrs/week

- Approx PHP 7,800/month (USD $140/week)



Full-time after successful 60-day trial:

- $9/hour, 40 hrs/week

- Approx PHP 87,000/month (USD $1,560/month)

- HMO health insurance stipend ($40/month, you pick Maxicare or Intellicare)

- 13th month bonus (full Filipino standard)

- Paid time off (10 days/year, accrues from full-time start)

- Annual raises based on performance



REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor's degree (UP, Ateneo, La Salle, UST, or top regional university preferred - but exceptional candidates from other schools will be considered)

- Excellent spoken English with a neutral or American-leaning accent (this is non-negotiable - you will be on the phone with US customers daily)

- Reliable internet (25+ Mbps), backup power, quiet workspace, USB headset

- Warm and patient on the phone - many of our customers are calling about a broken AC in 90-degree heat. They need someone calm and kind.

- Honest, fast learner, good at solving small problems on your own



NICE TO HAVE (not required)

- Prior US-account BPO experience (calling US customers)

- Experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, or similar field-service software

- Experience with ManyChat, Sendbird, or other chat tools



HOW TO APPLY - READ CAREFULLY

We will ONLY consider applications that include ALL THREE of the following. Applications missing any item will be rejected without review.



1. Your resume (PDF or link)



2. A 60-90 second Loom or YouTube (unlisted) video of yourself, speaking in English, answering this question:

"Tell me about a time you had to handle an upset customer or solve a problem with limited information. What did you do, and what was the outcome?"



3. Your written answer (3-5 sentences) to this scenario:

A customer texts you at 7pm on a Tuesday: My AC stopped working last night and it is 90 degrees in here. I have a baby. When can someone come? What is your reply, and what do you do next on our side?



WHY THESE THREE

We have hired many people. The ones who succeed always do these three things well: communicate clearly in writing, speak warmly on camera, and think practically about customer problems. We are not testing for the perfect answer - we are testing for how you think.



TIMELINE

- Applications close: 7 days from posting

- Video interviews: Week of June 1-5, 2026

- Start date: June 8, 2026



We are hiring ONE person now. If this works well, we will hire a second person in Q3 2026.



Thank you for reading this far. We look forward to meeting you.



- Joseph

Owner, Big Air Heat and A/C

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Bookkeeper / Admin / Revenue Control (QuickBooks + Excel)
description:
We're a growing flower business looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper who genuinely enjoys making numbers tie out to the penny. You'll own the daily financial pulse of the business — tracking every sale across Shopify, cash, and Zelle, reconciling team logs against actual payments, and catching discrepancies before they become problems.



This is not a passive data-entry role. We need someone who notices when something doesn't add up and digs until they find out why.



What You'll Do

Daily (the core of the job):

*Record all sales across Shopify, cash, and Zelle in QuickBooks

*Reconcile the team's daily sales logs against actual payments received

*Track inventory movement (incoming, sold, remaining, wastage)

*Flag discrepancies, missing items, or anything that looks off

*Submit a daily report summarizing sales, cash position, and any variances



Weekly:

*Maintain Excel reports for sales, inventory, and cash trends

*Prepare a weekly summary report for the owner

Reconcile bank activity and payment processor payouts



As needed:

*Respond to customer messages when the team is tied up

*Support the owner with light admin tasks tied to financial operations



What We're Looking For

Required:

*Real QuickBooks experience (you can explain the difference between a sales receipt and an invoice without thinking)

*Strong Excel skills — pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and you build formulas, not just formatted tables

*Multi-channel sales reconciliation experience (ideally Shopify + cash + a digital payment app like Zelle, PayPal, GCash, etc.)

*Honest, calm, and methodical — you document your work and aren't defensive when asked to explain it

*Clear English communication, written and spoken

*Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the daily report



Bonus points for:

*Retail or perishable inventory experience

*Bookkeeping for a US-based small business

*Experience reconciling Shopify payouts (you know payout timing and fee handling)



What This Job Is Not

*It's not a place to learn QuickBooks from scratch — we need someone who already works in it daily.

*It's not a 9-to-5 with someone watching over you. You'll work independently, which means missed reports are immediately visible.

*It's not a stepping stone — we want someone who'll grow with us for at least 18–24 months. Bonuses and pay increases are tied to performance and tenure.



How to Apply

Send the following to 

1. A 1–2 minute voice recording answering this question: "Walk me through how you would handle this situation — at the end of the day, the team's sales log shows $1,847 in cash sales, but the cash drawer only has $1,790. What do you do?"

2. A sample of your bookkeeping or Excel work — a sanitized reconciliation, sales report, or inventory tracker you've actually built. Screenshots or files are fine. Templates downloaded from the internet don't count.

3. A short note with:

*Your years of QuickBooks experience

*Your current timezone and weekly hours of availability

*One sentence on why this role fits you right now



Applications missing any of these three items will not be reviewed. We're serious about detail — the application itself is the first test.

title: Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator
description:
Who is Bare?

Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator to manage operations for our Australian business. This multi-faceted role is critical to maintaining seamless daily logistics. You will be responsible for orchestrating domestic and corporate travel, managing supplier procurement in line with local compliance, and assisting with the maintenance and safety of our corporate fleet.

The ideal candidate understands the Australian vendor landscape, has experience managing corporate travel across ANZ, and brings a strong customer-service focus to supporting our local workforce.



Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Management (Approx. 40%)

Booking & Domestic Logistics: Coordinate extensive corporate travel bookings across Australia (interstate) including flights (Qantas, Virgin Australia, Jetstar), corporate accommodation, and car rentals.

Policy Compliance: Enforce the company’s travel and expense policy, ensuring cost-efficient booking habits and appropriate tier selections.



TMC & Platform Management: Act as the primary administrator for the corporate travel management platform (e.g., Corporate Traveller, FCM, or Serko) and handle corporate profile updates.



Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) & Expense Alignment: Support the Finance team by ensuring travel expenses are accurately categorized to assist with FBT reporting and tracking meals/entertainment allowances.



2. Procurement & Supplier Relations (Approx. 40%)

Local Sourcing: Raise purchase requisitions and manage the end-to-end purchase order (PO) process for Australian suppliers, covering office supplies, IT equipment, and operational materials.



Vendor Management: Onboard new vendors, track supplier performance, and maintain compliant records including valid Australian Business Numbers (ABNs) and GST status verification.



Payment Lifecycle Collaboration: Reconcile invoices against delivery receipts and POs, liaising closely with the Accounts Payable team to ensure adherence to agreed payment terms.



Modern Slavery Act Compliance: Assist the procurement team in verifying supplier compliance in alignment with corporate social responsibility guidelines and local Modern Slavery reporting frameworks.



3. Fleet Management Assistance (Approx. 20%)

Asset Tracking & Registration: Maintain an updated corporate fleet registry, ensuring all vehicle registrations (via relevant state bodies like VicRoads, Transport for NSW, TMR, etc.) and compulsory third-party (CTP) insurances are systematically renewed.



Maintenance & Safety: Coordinate scheduled logbook servicing, tyre replacements, and vehicle inspections to maintain fleet safety and uphold manufacturer warranties.



Fuel Cards & Linkt/E-Toll Management: Monitor corporate fuel card accounts (e.g., Ampol, BP, Shell) and toll account usage (e.g., Linkt), reporting on weekly or monthly variances.



I
 Management: Assist drivers with a
 reporting processes, insurance claims documentation, and coordinating roadside assistance when required.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an operations, procurement, or corporate travel coordination role within Australia. Previous exposure to vehicle fleet coordination or logistics is highly regarded.



Technical Systems: Proficiency with ERP/financial software (e.g., Xero, MYOB, SAP, NetSuite), expense management tools, and corporate travel software (e.g., Velocity, Concur).



Regulatory Understanding: Familiarity with Australian business operational requirements, including GST invoicing principles, state-based vehicle registration rules, and basic workplace safety requirements.



Communication & Negotiation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to handling internal staff requests and local vendor negotiations.



Problem-Solving: Strong situational awareness with the ability to resolve rapid shifts in logistics, such as travel disruptions or freight delays.



What We Offer

Competitive salary package.

Collaborative team environment with hybrid working flexibility.

Clear pathways for professional growth and career progression across the operations and procurement functions.

We are a social team at heart, and that is one constant that hasn’t changed with all the movement this economy and industry has seen. We have embraced a hybrid work model where local tea
mbers come in at least two days a week. This allows us to work from home and have flexibility, without altogether forgoing the excitement and 
nts of collaboration and inspiration you can only get from in-person time. Not to mention, we also genuinely enjoy spending time together and socializing.



We celebrate new ideas and prioritize a culture of trust and respect where tea
mbers can grow and take risks. Each quarter we host events under our four cultural pillars; health & wellness, personal & professional development, social good, and social. We are proud to have been named:

San Diego Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in: 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, Inc 5000 Regionals Fastest Growing Companies in: 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, and 2026, San Diego Business Journal’s Fastest Growing Private Companies list in 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, and 2024, Inc Best Workplaces list in: 2024 and 2025, and Inc. 5000 for the last 6 years (
)!



If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



Job Description

The Accounts Payable Coordinator is responsible for managing the end-to-end payables process at Wonderist Agency across both operating entities. This includes processing vendor invoices, reconciling statements, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining accurate financial records. This role works closely with the accounting team and executive suite and reports directly to Finance Operations Manager.



Key Responsibilities

Weekly

Review and process incoming vendor invoices across both entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing)

Match invoices to purchase orders or approvals and route for sign-off as needed

Respond to vendor inquiries regarding payment status within 24 hours

Log all payables in accounting software and ensure coding accuracy by department and entity

Flag any discrepancies, duplicate charges, or overbilling for resolution

Review and process approved employee expense reimbursements, ensuring proper coding and timely payment

Monitor and reconcile Rippling Spend corporate card transactions against receipts and coding by department and entity

Review and process contractor invoices, including 1099-eligible payments submitted via Rippling or directly by contractors

Attend weekly finance check-in with leadership; come prepared with a current AP snapshot including aged items, open disputes, and any items requiring a decision or escalation



Monthly

Reconcile vendor statements against internal records and resolve any variances

Prepare a monthly AP aging report

Process approved payment runs and confirm remittance details with vendors

Support month-end close by providing complete and accurate AP data

Maintain organized digital records of all invoices, approvals, and payment confirmations

Reconcile Rippling Spend corporate card statements against internal records and resolve any variances



Quarterly/As Needed

Assist with audit preparation by compiling AP documentation as requested

Identify opportunities to streamline AP workflows or improve vendor billing accuracy

Support annual 1099 preparation by maintaining accurate vendor payment records throughout the year

Participate in process improvement initiatives related to finance operations

Collect and maintain W-9s for all new vendors and contractors at time of onboarding; maintain accurate vendor master file to support 1099 preparation

Support annual 1099 preparation for all eligible vendors and contractors, including payments processed via Rippling and direct invoice



Performance Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

Invoice processing accuracy (target: 99%+)

On-time payment execution with no missed due dates

AP aging report delivery on schedule each month

Vendor dispute resolution time

Quality and completeness of records for month-end close



Essential Functions: What You’ll Do

Invoice Processing and Payment Execution: Review, code, and process vendor invoices with accuracy and urgency. Ensure all invoices are matched to proper approvals before payment. Execute payment runs on schedule and confirm remittance with vendors as appropriate.

Vendor Relationship Management: Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for vendor billing inquiries. Maintain professional and responsive communication to protect vendor relationships while advocating for Wonderist's financial interests when discrepancies arise.

Discrepancy Resolution: Identify and investigate billing errors, duplicate charges, and overbilling situations. Document disputes clearly, communicate with vendors to reach resolution, and ensure credits or corrections are reflected accurately in the system.

Record Keeping and Reporting: Maintain complete and organized AP records in the accounting system. Produce monthly aging reports and provide data to support month-end close, audits, and leadership reporting as needed.

Cross-Entity Coordination: Manage payables across both operating entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing), applying accurate entity coding and maintaining clear separation of records.

Rippling Spend and Expense Management: Reconcile corporate card transactions in Rippling Spend and process employee reimbursement requests. Ensure all card activity is coded accurately by department and entity and that receipts and approvals are documented.

Inter-Entity Transactions: Support accurate coding and reconciliation of any shared costs or allocated expenses across Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing, maintaining clear separation of records between entities.



Core Competencies: What you’ll bring to the role

Attention to Detail: You catch errors before they become problems. You verify totals, check coding, and review statements line by line. Nothing gets processed without confirmation.

Integrity: You handle sensitive financial information with discretion and operate with a high standard of accuracy and honesty.

Organization and Follow-Through: You manage a high volume of invoices and vendor communications without letting anything fall through the cracks. You maintain clear records and follow up proactively.

Communication and Professionalism: You correspond clearly and professionally with vendors and internal tea
mbers. You escalate issues with the right information and context so they can be resolved quickly.

Systems Proficiency: You are comfortable working in accounting software and picking up new tools. Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms is essential. Experience with Rippling Spend, 
, or similar platforms is a plus



Must-Have Qualifications

2+ years of accounts payable or bookkeeping experience

Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar

Strong command of written English for vendor and internal communication

High attention to detail and comfort working with high-volume invoice environments

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with minimal supervision

Reliable internet connection and ability to work during Pacific Time business hours (partial overlap required)

Payment execution authority will be granted by leadership up to an approved threshold; comfort initiating and confirming payment runs within those parameters is required



Bonus Points for Applicants With…

(if you don’t have these but are organized and want to learn, we want to hear from you!)

Experience supporting multi-entity accounting environments

Familiarity with Rippling, Ramp, 
, or similar platforms

Background in agency, marketing, or professional services environments

Experience with 1099 preparation and vendor compliance

title: Video Editor & Content Manager
description:
Exciting opportunity to work directly with GoFunnels Founder Maazin to create content for his personal brand



WHO WE ARE



GoFunnels is a done-for-you funnel building and revenue infrastructure firm. We've built over 2,000 funnels and optimized 1,000+ GoHighLevel accounts for clients including Gym Launch, Brian Tracy, and Valuetainment.



We're building a personal brand around our founder. The content is direct, high-energy, and built for founders and business owners in the $10K-$500K/month range. Think business content with substance, not fluff. No motivational quotes over sunset backgrounds.





THE ROLE



You'll be our in-house video editor and content manager, working directly with the founder. He shoots the content. You turn it into everything else.



That means editing short-form reels, long-form YouTube videos, ad creatives, and VSLs. It also means posting content, managing the content calendar, and being actively involved in content strategy. You're not just cutting clips. You're thinking about what formats are trending, what hooks will stop the scroll, what's working on the platform right now, and bringing those ideas to the table.



This is a creative partnership, not an assembly line. You'll have direct access to the founder daily. If you've worked in environments where you get raw footage and a brief and then disappear for a week, this isn't that. This is fast-paced, collaborative, and iterative.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO EVERY MONTH



30 short-form reels (Instagram, TikTok, Shorts). That's roughly one per day. These need to be punchy, hook-driven, and edited for retention. Not just cuts and captions. You should understand pacing, pattern interrupts, visual storytelling, and what makes someone stop scrolling.



4 long-form YouTube videos. Full edits including cuts, b-roll, graphics, transitions, chapters, and thumbnails. These are educational and authority-building content for a business audience. They need to feel professional without being overproduced.



Ad creatives and VSLs as needed. We run Meta ads and need video creatives edited to direct response standards. You should understand the difference between content that entertains and content that converts. If you've edited ads or sales videos before, you know what this means. If you haven't, this will be a steep learning curve. But we have examples of videos we can share with you to get you up to speed



Post and schedule all content. You own the publishing workflow. That means uploading, writing captions, adding hashtags, scheduling posts at optimal times, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll manage posting across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and any other platforms we expand to. Of course you can use AI to help with captions



Content strategy input. You're expected to bring ideas, not just wait for assignments. What trending formats should we try? What hooks are working right now? What did we post last week that performed and why? What should we double down on? You don't need to be a marketing strategist, but you need to think like someone who cares about growth, not just edits.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Strong portfolio of short-form and long-form work. Show us reels you've edited that actually performed. Show us YouTube videos where the pacing and editing elevated the content. If your portfolio is only wedding videos or corporate explainers, this probably isn't the right fit. 



We need someone who lives in the short-form content world and understands what performs on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube right now.



Proficiency in professional editing tools. Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut Pro, or equivalent. You should be fast and comfortable in at least one professional NLE and have motion graphics capability for lower thirds, text animations, and visual elements.



Genuine interest in AI editing tools. We use and experiment with AI tools like Higgsfield, Runway, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, and whatever else is emerging. This space moves fast. If you're the type of editor who actively seeks out new AI tools, tests them, and integrates them into your workflow, that's exactly what we want. If you're resistant to AI or think it's a gimmick, we're not aligned.



Understanding of hooks and retention editing. You should know that the first 1-3 seconds of a reel determine whether anyone watches the rest. You should edit with that in mind. Quick cuts, pattern interrupts, visual hooks, text overlays timed to speech. If someone says "hook-based editing" and you know exactly what that means, good.



Eye for brand consistency. Our aesthetic is dark, clean, high-contrast with green accents. Think premium, not playful. You'll develop a feel for the brand over time, but you should have the design instinct to maintain visual consistency across dozens of pieces of content per month.



Platform knowledge. You should know the difference between what works on Instagram Reels vs. TikTok vs. YouTube Shorts vs. long-form YouTube. Aspect ratios, ideal lengths, caption placement, trending audio, algorithm behavior. This is table stakes if you've been in the short-form content world.



Self-directed and organized. 30+ pieces of content per month means you need a system. You need to manage your own queue, track what's been edited, what's been posted, what's in review. If you need someone to micromanage your task list, you'll fall behind fast.



Good communicator. You're working directly with the founder. That means quick Slack responses, clear questions when something's ambiguous, and honest pushback when you think an edit direction isn't working. Not a yes-person. A creative collaborator who can articulate why they made an editing choice.





WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR



Editors who only know one format. If you've only done long-form or only done reels, you'll struggle with the range this role demands. We need someone who can switch between a 15-second reel and a 20-minute YouTube video without losing quality on either.



Template-dependent editors. If your workflow is "download a template pack, swap in footage, export," that's not editing. We need someone with real creative instinct who can build from scratch when needed.



People who treat posting as an afterthought. The posting and scheduling side of this role is not secondary. If you see yourself as "just an editor" and consider posting beneath you, this isn't the right fit. Content that's edited but never posted doesn't exist.



Slow turnaround without communication. At our volume, things move fast. If you're going to miss a deadline, say so early. What we can't work with is silence followed by a late delivery. Speed and communication beat perfection every time.





HOURS AND SCHEDULE



Full-time, 40 hours per week. You'll be working UK business hours for collaboration and real-time feedback with the founder. The role requires daily communication and fast turnaround, so you need to be online and responsive during these hours.





HOW TO APPLY



Step 1: Send your resume and a link to your portfolio. We want to see reels, YouTube videos, or ad creatives you've edited. If you don't have a portfolio link, put together a Google Drive folder with your 5-10 best pieces. At least some of these should be short-form content (reels, TikTok, Shorts).



Step 2: Record a short Loom (under 2 minutes) walking us through one piece in your portfolio. Tell us what the brief was, what creative decisions you made, and what you'd do differently now. This tells us more about how you think than the edit itself.



Step 3: Answer this in your application: "You get 45 minutes of raw talking-head footage from the founder about a business topic. Your job is to turn it into 3 reels and 1 YouTube video. Walk us through your process from receiving the footage to having all 4 pieces ready to post."



Step 4: If we like what we see, you'll have a short interview with our founder.



We're hiring one person for this role. If your work speaks for itself, we'll know.



Best,

Maazin

Founder, GoFunnels

description:
Real Estate Video Editor Premiere Pro 400 Dollars a Month



We are a growing real estate media company looking for a full time video editor to join our team for the long term. We specialize in producing premium one minute cinematic videos for our real estate clients. We are specifically looking for an individual with an open mindset who genuinely loves to learn and constantly improve. If you already have a solid grasp of Adobe Premiere Pro and want to master the art of cinematic storytelling and advanced color grading we want to help you elevate your skills.



Your daily routine will typically involve editing two to three videos per day though you should have the capacity to handle up to five videos during our peak periods. For each project we will provide you with a pool of 50 to 100 short raw clips. Your responsibility will be to sort through this footage select the absolute best shots and assemble a polished high quality one minute video. You will also need to apply beautiful color correction and grading to ensure the properties look luxurious and visually stunning.



Because many of our videos feature real estate agents speaking directly to the camera you must be highly proficient in English. Strong language skills are absolutely essential because we have zero tolerance for grammatical errors spelling mistakes or typos in the text overlays and captions of our final edits. You must have a sharp eye for detail to ensure all spoken words are transcribed and displayed perfectly.



To qualify for this position you must be highly proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro. You also need a powerful computer setup that can process and render heavy footage efficiently without performance issues. A high speed internet connection is mandatory so you can smoothly download large batches of raw clips daily and upload the final edits without delays. Most importantly you must possess a growth mindset and welcome constructive feedback as a tool to sharpen your craft.



The compensation for this position is 400 dollars per month. This is a stable full time role that offers long term security along with clear opportunities for financial growth and bonuses as our business scales and your editing workflow becomes more efficient.



To apply for this role please send us a message with the subject line Ready to Edit Real Estate followed by your name. In your message please include a link to your portfolio or past video work. Additionally please attach a screenshot of your internet speed test and a brief description of your current computer hardware specifications.

title: Operations VA, Swing Shift — Short-Term Rental Remote
description:
Company: Sunshine Club Rentals | Type: Full-Time | Pay: $500/month

Schedule: Mon–Wed 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM ET (evenings) + Sat–Sun 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM ET (overnights) | Days off: Thu, Fri | Reports To: Operations Manager



THE ROLE

We're a premium STR company managing vacation properties across Florida. We need a detail-oriented, proactive Operations VA to cover our evening and overnight windows — the hours when most of the team is off and our guests need someone on call.



You'll work under our Operations Manager as part of a close-knit remote team. You follow SOPs, solve problems before escalating, and take full ownership of your tasks from start to finish. You're the one keeping the lights on while everyone else is asleep — that's a big deal.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Monitor and respond to guest communications through our tools, following SOPs

Coordinate with cleaning and maintenance vendors during late-day handoffs and weekend overnight emergencies — assign tasks, follow up, confirm completion

Handle late-night guest issues independently — lockouts, smart lock troubleshooting, Wi-Fi, noise complaints

Flag and track property issues until fully resolved — no open loops

Keep Notion task boards updated and accurate

Escalate to the Operations Manager only after exhausting your own resources



YOU MUST HAVE

STR, property management, or hospitality experience

Strong written English — you're communicating with guests and vendors daily

Extreme attention to detail and follow-through

Ability to problem-solve independently before asking for help — especially during overnight hours when no one else is on

Reliability — you show up, you follow through, you communicate

Genuine ability to work the swing schedule (evenings AND weekend overnights) without it wrecking your sleep, your family, or your reliability



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You need to be told what to do next

You let tasks sit without following up

You disappear when things get busy

You're hoping to flip this to a daytime shift later — this is a permanent swing role

Weekend overnights conflict with your life (childcare, school, second job, family)



TOOLS

Hospitable · HostBuddy · Turno · Notion · Claude AI



COMPENSATION & PROCESS:



$500/month

2-week paid trial before full offer

Interview ? scenario test ? trial





HOW TO APPLY



 

Subject line: "Always On — Swing Shift VA Application"

(Wrong subject line = not reviewed. Missing any of the four items below = not reviewed.)



Your application must include all four of the following:



1. Resume with STR or hospitality experience highlighted

2. A 2–3 min video (Loom, YouTube unlisted, or Google Drive) — introduce yourself, share your relevant experience, give one example of solving a problem on your own without being told what to do, and tell us specifically why a swing schedule (weekday evenings + weekend overnights) works for your life

3. Written answer: It's 3 AM Saturday. A guest messages saying they're locked out, the smart lock won't respond, and they have a baby with them. The Operations Manager is asleep. Walk us through exactly what you do.

4. Complete the free DISC personality assessment at 
/disc-personality-test and include a screenshot summary of your results

title: Sr. Recruiting Coordinator/Recruiter
description:
ABOUT STAFFOR CONSULTING



Staffor Consulting LLC is a McKinney, TX-based nuclear and utility staffing firm with over 20 years of exclusive focus in the energy sector. We serve as a Tier 1 preferred vendor and premier supplier across multiple MSP programs, partnering with leading managed service providers including Pinnacle Group, Allegis Global Solutions, and Guidant Global.



With approximately 50–60 active consultants deployed across the country at any given time, Staffor supports nuclear power plants, investor-owned utilities, and independent power producers with highly specialized technical talent — including nuclear operations, instrumentation & controls, maintenance, engineering, planning & scheduling, and project management professionals.



Our reputation is built on two things: the quality of every candidate we submit and the speed at which we deliver them. In MSP-managed programs, those two things are non-negotiable. We are looking for a sourcing professional who lives by the same standard.



POSITION OVERVIEW



The MSP Sourcer / Recruiting Coordinator is a critical, fast-paced role responsible for identifying, qualifying, and submitting top-tier candidates into active requisitions managed through our MSP partner portals. This position operates at the front line of Staffor's delivery operation — where speed, accuracy, and candidate quality directly impact our Tier 1 vendor standing and client relationships.



This is not a passive recruiting role. You will be working in a live submission-window environment where being 30–60 minutes late on a submittal can mean a candidate is never reviewed. You must be able to move from a new job requirement to active candidate outreach in under 20 minutes, manage multiple live reqs simultaneously under real deadline pressure, and consistently submit candidates who are genuinely qualified — not just keyword-matched.



If you thrive in high-urgency environments, take personal ownership of outcomes, and understand that a fast but wrong submission is worse than no submission at all — this role was built for you.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Sourcing & Outreach

• Receive new requisitions from MSP partner portals and initiate candidate outreach within 20 minutes of receipt

• Execute multi-channel outbound sourcing campaigns via LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean/X-Ray search, job boards, ATS databases, and direct outreach tools

• Build and maintain a live hotlist of pre-qualified, submission-ready candidates for high-frequency nuclear and utility roles

• Engage passive candidates through personalized, credible outreach — not mass blasting

• Source against tight submission windows without sacrificing candidate quality or fit



Candidate Qualification & Screening

• Conduct rapid phone screens to verify technical alignment, availability, compensation expectations, work authorization, location, and motivation

• Distinguish between genuinely qualified candidates and keyword matches — verify that candidates understand and have owned the work on their resume

• Exercise judgment to hold back submittals when candidate fit is questionable, even under deadline pressure

• Prepare polished, MSP-ready candidate profiles and resumes for submission

• Maintain consistent screening non-negotiables across every role regardless of urgency level



Requisition Management

• Manage 10–30+ simultaneous open requisitions across multiple client programs

MSP Portal & ATS Operations

Communication & Coordination

• Represent Staffor with professionalism in every candidate and client-facing interaction



WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED



Required Qualifications

• Minimum 2 years of recruiting or sourcing experience in a staffing agency, MSP, or high-volume environment

• Demonstrated experience managing 10+ simultaneous open requisitions under real submission-window pressure

• Proven ability to move from req receipt to first candidate outreach in under 20 minutes

• Strong candidate qualification instincts — ability to distinguish real fit from resume keyword matching

• Experience conducting structured phone screens with consistent non-negotiable checkpoints

• Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean/X-Ray search techniques

• Familiarity with at least one ATS platform (Bullhorn strongly preferred)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Full availability during US Central business hours

• Reliable high-speed internet connection suitable for continuous remote work and voice calls



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in nuclear, power generation, utilities, or energy sector staffing

• Familiarity with MSP/VMS environments (Fieldglass, Beeline, Workday, SAP Fieldglass)

• Experience with Pinnacle Group, Allegis Global Solutions, or Guidant Global programs

• Knowledge of nuclear or utility job families: operations, I&C, maintenance, engineering, project management

• Experience using contact data tools such as SignalHire, Apollo, or ZoomInfo for passive candidate outreach

• Proficiency with outreach automation or CRM platforms



Non-Negotiable Requirements

• Must be available full-time during US Central business hours — no exceptions

• Must have a reliable, high-speed WiFi connection — this role requires uninterrupted availability for sourcing, calls, and portal activity

• Must submit a voice or video introduction as part of your application — candidates who do not include this will not be advanced

• Must be able to manage urgency independently without supervision — this is a fully remote role



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In Your First 30 Days At Full Performance

• Fully onboarded into all active MSP portals

• Familiar with Staffor's active client programs and preferred candidate profiles

• Actively working live reqs with zero missed submission windows

• Building initial hotlist of nuclear and utility candidates • Consistently submitting within all MSP submission windows

• Maintaining high candidate quality — low rejection rate from MSP reviewers

• Managing 15–25+ simultaneous reqs independently

• Contributing to Staffor's Tier 1 vendor performance metrics



WHO WE ARE — AND WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Staffor has spent 20+ years earning and protecting its Tier 1 status in nuclear and utility staffing. That reputation is built submission by submission, placement by placement. The person who takes this role will be a direct extension of that standard.



We are not looking for someone who needs to be managed. We are looking for someone who sets the pace — who feels the urgency of a live submission window the same way we do, who takes personal ownership of every candidate they put forward, and who understands that this work matters because the facilities we staff matter.



If you have worked in a high-stakes MSP or agency environment, know what it means to win or lose a placement by minutes, and take pride in the quality of every submission you make — we want to hear from you.
