title: Influencer Marketing & UGC Coordinator
description:
?  IMMEDIATE HIRE — Position Open Now  ?

Role Summary

We are a US-based tire sealant manufacturer hiring a part-time Virtual Assistant to manage influencer outreach and user-generated content (UGC) for our consumer brand. You will own the creator pipeline end-to-end — finding the right influencers, managing outreach, coordinating content creation, tracking performance, and building our library of authentic UGC assets. This is a focused, execution-oriented role, not general social media management.

We target three audiences: ATV/UTV riders, lawn and landscaping enthusiasts, and cyclists. You will work across Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube to recruit and manage micro-influencers and UGC creators in those spaces.



Quick Facts

Brand US tire sealant manufacturer — consumer DTC (ATV/UTV, Lawn, Cycling)

Role Type Part-time VA, Independent Contractor

Location Philippines-based preferred; fully remote

Hours Part-time approx. 15-20 hrs/week — potential to grow to full-time

Pay Competitive hourly rate — based on experience

Reports To Business Owner (US-based)

Start Date IMMEDIATE — position is open now

Platform OnlineJobs.ph direct hire; paid via Payoneer



What You Will Own

1. Influencer Discovery & Vetting

• Search Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and
 for micro-influencers (10K–100K followers) in ATV/UTV, outdoor power equipment/lawn, and cycling niches

• Evaluate accounts for audience authenticity, engagement rate, content quality, and niche fit — not just follower count

• Build and maintain a vetted creator shortlist tracked in Microsoft Planner (part of our MS 365 stack)

• Flag accounts with fake followers, low engagement, or brand-safety issues before outreach



2. Outreach & Relationship Management

• Send personalized DMs and
s to qualified creators using approved templates

• Track responses, follow up systematically, and move creators through the pipeline (contacted ? interested ? negotiating ? active ? complete)

• Negotiate product-for-content and commission-only arrangements; escalate paid deals to business owner for approval

• Maintain a clean CRM or tracker log with status, next steps, and notes for every creator contact



3. UGC Content Coordination

• Brief selected creators with product info, key messages, and content guidelines — no guesswork for the creator

• Set deadlines, follow up on content submissions, and flag late or off-brief deliverables early

• Collect raw and final assets (photos, videos, Reels, TikToks) and organize in our OneDrive folder structure

• Obtain usage rights documentation or written approval before content is used in paid or organic posts



4. Performance Tracking

• Log post performance (views, likes, saves, comments, link clicks) for every influencer activation

• Track promo code redemptions and affiliate link clicks using our affiliate platform (currently SliceWP on WooCommerce — platform may transition; adaptability required but not leaving the WC platform)

• Compile a weekly one-page summary: new contacts, active campaigns, content received, and top-performing posts

• Flag underperforming creators before contracts are renewed



5. Content Library Management

• Maintain an organized OneDrive library with all UGC assets tagged by niche (ATV, Lawn, Cycling), format (video, photo, Reel), and usage rights status

• Repurpose approved UGC clips and images into social post descriptions, ad briefs, and Amazon & Wal Mart listing assets as directed

• Coordinate with the social media team when UGC is approved for posting or boosting



Required Qualifications

• 2+ years managing influencer outreach or affiliate/creator programs — not just social media posting

• Proven experience running DM and
 outreach campaigns with high response rates

• Solid understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube creator ecosystems — how accounts grow, how engagement works, and what fake followers look like

• Strong written and spoken English — outreach messages and briefs must be professional and brand-appropriate

• Experience building and maintaining influencer/creator tracking spreadsheets or CRM pipelines

• Comfortable working independently with minimal hand-holding; proactive communicator



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with WooCommerce-compatible affiliate/promo code tracking platforms (SliceWP, Refersion, Impact, ShareASale, or similar)

• Background working with US consumer or DTC e-commerce brands

• Familiarity with ATV/UTV, outdoor power equipment, or cycling audiences

• Experience negotiating creator deals or managing product-seeding programs

• Basic video/image review skills — ability to evaluate raw UGC for quality and brand fit



What You Are NOT Doing

This role is not social media management. You are not writing captions, scheduling posts, or running ads. You are building and managing the creator and content pipeline that feeds those channels.



Tools You Will Use

Outreach Tracking Microsoft Planner & Teams (MS 365 — training provided)

Communication Microsoft Teams,
, Instagram DM, TikTok DM

Affiliate Tracking SliceWP on WooCommerce (platform may transition — adaptability required)

Content Storage OneDrive (organized folder structure — template provided)

Performance Data Native platform analytics (Instagram Insights, TikTok Analytics)

Payments to Creators Payoneer or Paypal — handled by business owner



Schedule & Communication

• Async-first role — you manage your own schedule within agreed weekly hour blocks

• Weekly check-in: short written update submitted every Friday (template provided)

• Response time expectation: reply to owner messages within 24 hours Mon–Fri

• Video call availability: able to join a 1-hour call once per week with Marketing Team

• US holidays observed; Philippines holidays noted — schedule around them proactively



Performance Expectations — First 90 Days

Days 1–14 Learn the brand, audiences, and product; review approved content examples; set up tracking sheet

Days 15–30 Identify and vet 50+ qualified creator prospects per niche; begin outreach

Days 31–60 First active creator partnerships live; UGC content pieces received and catalogued

Days 61–90 Weekly tracking routine established; first performance report delivered; pipeline at 20+ active contacts



How to Apply

To be considered, please send the following:

• Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile link

• A short summary (3–5 sentences) of an influencer or UGC campaign you managed — what the niche was, what you did, and what the result was

• 2–3 examples of outreach messages you have actually sent to creators (screenshots or copy/paste — no need to be perfect, just real)

• Your requested hourly rate in USD



Applications without the campaign summary and outreach examples will not be reviewed. We are a lean team and this is a real, long-term role — we want to see what you have actually done.

They are comfortable coordinating across teams, managing operational data, maintaining accurate records, and supporting manufacturing and supply chain workflows in a fast-paced environment.



This is a remote role based in the Philippines. Candidates must have prior experience supporting manufacturing or operational workflows using Acumatica. 



Key Responsibilities

-- Assist leadership with reporting, scheduling, follow-up, and operational coordination

-- Support communication and coordination across internal teams and external partners

-- Help ensure operational tasks are completed accurately and on schedule



Process Improvement & Documentation

-- Identify inefficiencies and help improve operational systems and workflows

-- Maintain accurate documentation of procedures and operational activities

-- Assist with development of scalable systems to support company growth

-- Support implementation of new operational tools, processes, and reporting structures



Quality & Accuracy

-- Maintain high standards for data accuracy and operational organization

-- Ensure inventory, manufacturing, and purchasing records remain current and reliable

-- Support quality control and process consistency across operational systems



KPI Ownership & Accountability

-- Help track operational KPIs, production metrics, and inventory accuracy

-- Monitor task completion and operational deadlines

-- Escalate issues proactively when operational risks or inconsistencies arise



Required Qualifications

-- Hands-on experience using Acumatica Manufacturing Edition in a manufacturing, production, or operations environment

-- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail

-- Experience maintaining operational records, documentation, and reporting systems

-- Strong written and verbal English communication skills

-- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving startup environment

Preferred Qualifications

-- Experience supporting manufacturing, agriculture, horticulture, or supply chain operations

-- Experience with purchasing, inventory reconciliation, or logistics coordination

-- Familiarity with SOP development and process documentation

-- Experience supporting U.S.-based companies or distributed teams



Key Characteristics

-- Detail-Oriented: You catch inconsistencies and maintain high standards for operational accuracy

-- Process-Driven: You enjoy improving workflows and building scalable systems

-- Reliable: You consistently follow through on tasks and communicate proactively

title: Senior Bookkeeper / Finance Operator — US Telehealth Subscription Company (Remote)
description:
$1,800/mo - Full time role. 



Summary

We're a US-based telehealth subscription company running on Stripe + QuickBooks Online. We're hiring a senior bookkeeper / finance operator to own the full finance ops function — not just reconciliation, but budgeting, forecasting, payroll, tax compliance, and reporting that actually drives decisions.



This is a long-term role with significant growth potential. We're small now but scaling fast. The right person will grow into a finance manager / controller role as we scale the business, hire a team, and prepare for our next funding round.



We're looking for an A-player: sharp, meticulous, trustworthy, loyal, deeply organized, and operating well above my level on this stuff. I don't want to hand-hold — I want you to lead us in the right direction and grow with the company long term.



---



IMMEDIATE PRIORITIES (FIRST 60 DAYS)



Before steady-state work begins, we have two critical projects that need to be done fast and done right:



1) Finalize end-of-year books for 2025 — ASAP. Our 2025 books need to be closed and packaged for our US CPA immediately. This includes full reconciliation, accruals, deferred revenue cleanup, prepaid COGS schedules, and a year-end close package. This is your first deliverable and the timeline is tight.



2) Set up Synder RevRec. We've selected Synder for subscription revenue recognition (Stripe to QBO). You'll lead the implementation: configuring product-to-account mapping, setting recognition methods per subscription type, validating the waterfall against historical Stripe data, and posting the first month of journal entries cleanly into QBO.



If neither of these excites you, this isn't the right role.



---



ABOUT US



- US-based telehealth subscription business, funded C-corp

- Stack: Stripe (billing), QuickBooks Online, Mercury (banking), Gusto (payroll), Synder RevRec (implementing)

- Subscription mix: monthly, 6-month, and 12-month plans

- US-based founders, fully remote team



---



WHAT YOU'LL OWN (ONGOING)



Weekly:



- Review weekly payment reports from our clinical vendor — verify accuracy of revenue and costs, push back on errors and incorrect charges

- Post vendor numbers into QuickBooks Online (grossed up revenue and costs, split by subscription type: initial vs. 6-month vs. 12-month)

- Reconcile QBO against Mercury bank feed (all costs, credit cards, transfers)

- Weekly P&L flash report



Monthly:



- Review deferred revenue recognition (Synder RevRec auto-posts; you verify the waterfall vs. cash received, investigate variances)

- Calculate cost accruals (incurred but not yet billed)

- Calculate prepaid COGS amortization for 6/12-month subscriptions (we pay clinical costs upfront; need to match against revenue recognition schedule)

- Monthly P&L, balance sheet, cashflow summary

- Variance reporting: actuals vs. forecast, with commentary on what's driving deltas

- Review Gusto payroll runs, reconcile to QBO, confirm payroll taxes filed correctly



Payroll and tax compliance (ongoing):



- Own Gusto end to end: payroll runs, contractor payments, benefits sync, year-end W-2s and 1099s

- Make sure we're registered for the correct state payroll taxes in every state we have employees or contractors (this is basic but critical — we don't want surprise notices)

- Track filing deadlines for federal and state payroll, sales tax, and franchise tax; coordinate with our US CPA on income tax

- Maintain a clean compliance calendar so nothing slips



Quarterly + annually:



- Build and maintain rolling 12-month forecast with scenario modeling

- Departmental budgets (marketing, clinical, ops, G&A) — work with department leads to build bottoms-up budgets and hold them accountable

- Year-end close package for our US CPA (full ledger, supporting schedules, audit-ready)

- Year-end 1099 issuance and W-2 reconciliation through Gusto



---



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 5+ years bookkeeping or financial controller experience for US companies

- REQUIRED: You have personally closed at least one set of US company year-end books for a CPA package (we will ask for specifics)

- REQUIRED: Deep QuickBooks Online experience, including journal entries, classes, custom reporting, and chart of accounts design

- REQUIRED: Hands-on Gusto experience — running payroll, managing state tax registrations, handling W-2s and 1099s

- REQUIRED: Hands-on experience with subscription revenue recognition under ASC 606 (deferred revenue, recognition schedules, prepaid expense amortization)

- REQUIRED: Stripe experience — you understand subscriptions, refunds, disputes, prorations, chargebacks at the data level

- STRONGLY PREFERRED: Hands-on Synder, TrueRev, Maxio, or similar revenue recognition tool implementation experience (not just usage — actual setup from scratch)

- Strong Google Sheets / Excel modeling skills (we'll ask you to build a forecast)

- Excellent written English — you'll be in Slack and
 with the team regularly

- Self-directed: we don't want to micromanage. We want someone who flags issues before we ask, builds SOPs without being told, and owns outcomes

- MUST be available to work US business hours (Central Time preferred). This is non-negotiable. We need real-time overlap for Slack and quick syncs.



---



WHAT YOU'LL BRING BEYOND THE BASICS



We're specifically looking for someone who will:



- Push back when vendors make mistakes (this happens often and costs us real money if no one catches it)

- Build budgets with department owners, not just maintain spreadsheets

- Learn new software fast — we run on a modern stack and add tools regularly

- Improve processes, not just execute them. We want our finance ops to be excellent, not just functional

- Stay ahead of compliance deadlines so we never get a state tax notice we weren't expecting

- Eventually own the relationship with our US CPA and external auditors



---



HOURS AND RATE



- Hours: Tell us in your proposal how many hours per week you think this scope actually requires to be done well, including budgets and forecasts delivered on time. Be specific about how many hours you'd need in the first 60 days (2025 close + Synder setup) versus steady-state. We want your honest assessment, not the answer you think we want to hear.



- Rate: Open. Tell us your hourly rate and justify it.



- Engagement: Long-term, ongoing. We're hiring for the next 5+ years, not the next 5 months. As the business scales, hours and scope grow with it.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Answer all four screening questions specifically. We will not consider any proposal that doesn't answer all four questions. Generic "I am detail-oriented and hardworking" replies will be rejected immediately.

title: Bookkeeper / Admin / Revenue Control (QuickBooks + Excel)
description:
We're a growing flower business looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper who genuinely enjoys making numbers tie out to the penny. You'll own the daily financial pulse of the business — tracking every sale across Shopify, cash, and Zelle, reconciling team logs against actual payments, and catching discrepancies before they become problems.



This is not a passive data-entry role. We need someone who notices when something doesn't add up and digs until they find out why.



What You'll Do

Daily (the core of the job):

*Record all sales across Shopify, cash, and Zelle in QuickBooks

*Reconcile the team's daily sales logs against actual payments received

*Track inventory movement (incoming, sold, remaining, wastage)

*Flag discrepancies, missing items, or anything that looks off

*Submit a daily report summarizing sales, cash position, and any variances



Weekly:

*Maintain Excel reports for sales, inventory, and cash trends

*Prepare a weekly summary report for the owner

Reconcile bank activity and payment processor payouts



As needed:

*Respond to customer messages when the team is tied up

*Support the owner with light admin tasks tied to financial operations



What We're Looking For

Required:

*Real QuickBooks experience (you can explain the difference between a sales receipt and an invoice without thinking)

*Strong Excel skills — pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and you build formulas, not just formatted tables

*Multi-channel sales reconciliation experience (ideally Shopify + cash + a digital payment app like Zelle, PayPal, GCash, etc.)

*Honest, calm, and methodical — you document your work and aren't defensive when asked to explain it

*Clear English communication, written and spoken

*Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the daily report



Bonus points for:

*Retail or perishable inventory experience

*Bookkeeping for a US-based small business

*Experience reconciling Shopify payouts (you know payout timing and fee handling)



What This Job Is Not

*It's not a place to learn QuickBooks from scratch — we need someone who already works in it daily.

*It's not a 9-to-5 with someone watching over you. You'll work independently, which means missed reports are immediately visible.

*It's not a stepping stone — we want someone who'll grow with us for at least 18–24 months. Bonuses and pay increases are tied to performance and tenure.



How to Apply

Send the following to 

1. A 1–2 minute voice recording answering this question: "Walk me through how you would handle this situation — at the end of the day, the team's sales log shows $1,847 in cash sales, but the cash drawer only has $1,790. What do you do?"

2. A sample of your bookkeeping or Excel work — a sanitized reconciliation, sales report, or inventory tracker you've actually built. Screenshots or files are fine. Templates downloaded from the internet don't count.

3. A short note with:

*Your years of QuickBooks experience

*Your current timezone and weekly hours of availability

*One sentence on why this role fits you right now



Applications missing any of these three items will not be reviewed. We're serious about detail — the application itself is the first test.

title: C# Programmer / Software Developer
description:
Part time, remote

10 to 20 hours per week to start

Pay based on experience



About the role



I’m looking for a C# developer to help debug, stabilize, and maintain a Windows Console game project.



The project is a text based RPG built in C#. It has grown quickly with help from Codex, so the codebase has a mix of working systems, messy patches, duplicated logic, and some fragile class and weapon behavior that needs a careful developer’s eye.



Right now, the biggest priority is cleaning up bugs in the player action system, especially where combat actions, HUD text, character sheet text, and weapon behavior don’t match.



This is not a full rewrite role. I need someone who can inspect the current code, understand the existing patterns, make surgical fixes, and keep the game playable while improving stability over time.



What you’ll help with



You’ll help debug and maintain a C# Windows Console project, including:



Finding and fixing bugs in player actions, weapon behavior, and combat UI

Cleaning up mismatched Q/W/E/T action names, descriptions, and behavior

Making sure the HUD, character sheet, and actual combat methods stay in sync

Reviewing AI generated code and identifying risky or broken logic

Refactoring small areas only when it clearly reduces bugs

Preserving existing working systems while improving stability

Helping organize messy code into clearer, safer patterns over time

Running builds, testing fixes, and explaining what changed

What I’m looking for



You’d be a good fit if you:



Have solid experience with C#

Can work comfortably in an existing codebase

Know how to debug without randomly rewriting everything

Can read messy code and figure out the safest fix

Care about maintainability and simple architecture

Are comfortable with console applications

Can communicate clearly about bugs, tradeoffs, and what you changed

Can work independently and ask good questions when something is unclear



Game development experience is a plus, but not required. Strong C# debugging skills matter more.



Nice to have

Experience with turn based games, RPG systems, or combat logic

Experience cleaning up AI generated code

Familiarity with GitHub

Comfort working with large files and legacy style code

Ability to create simple test plans before and after fixes

Current project needs



The immediate focus is stabilizing the combat action system. For example, some weapons currently have mismatched action names between the combat HUD, character sheet, and actual action methods. Some classes also have missing or incorrect Q/W/E/T displays.



I need help tracing those bugs to the source, fixing them safely, and preventing the same issue from spreading.



How to apply



Please include:



A short intro about you

Your experience with C#

Any experience debugging messy or AI generated code

A GitHub, portfolio, or code sample if you have one

Your availability per week

Your hourly rate or expected compensation



Bonus: briefly describe how you’d approach debugging a large C# file where the UI text and actual method behavior no longer match.

You will own the full billing cycle in Athena Health -- coding, submitting, and following up on claims across our carrier network -- while also supporting the clinical side with scribing, referrals, and chart preparation. If you take pride in accuracy, move quickly when a claim is stuck, and can hold your own in both billing and clinical workflows, this role was built for you.



What You Will Own



Billing & Insurance

— Code medical charts accurately using ICD-10 and CPT codes and submit claims through Athena Health

— Work all denied and pending claims -- diagnose the issue, correct it, and resubmit without delay

— Manage insurance credentialing and re-credentialing across our full carrier network

— Monitor the complete billing cycle from charge entry through payment posting and follow up on aging claims proactively

— Maintain accurate records of claim status, payer communications, and outstanding balances



Clinical Support

— Provide medical scribing support -- document patient encounters accurately and completely in Athena Health

— Process and track referrals to specialists and outside providers from initiation through confirmation

— Prepare patient charts 2 weeks in advance of scheduled visits -- all documentation complete and provider-ready

— Coordinate with clinical staff to ensure chart accuracy and completeness at both locations



What We Are Looking For



Non-Negotiables

— Minimum 3 years of hands-on medical billing experience -- family medicine, OBGYN, or urgent care required

— Proficiency with Athena Health as both an EMR and billing/clearinghouse platform -- not just familiarity

— Strong command of ICD-10, CPT coding, claim submission, and denial management workflows

— Active experience with insurance credentialing across multiple payers

— Ability to provide clinical support -- scribing, referral tracking, and chart prep -- within Athena Health

— Self-directed and organized -- there are no pre-built SOPs; you will need to establish your own rhythm with supervisor support

— HIPAA-compliant practices and a firm commitment to patient data privacy at all times

— Fluent, professional English -- written and verbal

— Reliable remote setup: stable high-speed internet, quiet private workspace, headset and webcam

— Willing to complete a brief cognitive and DISC assessment as part of the hiring process



Strong Pluses

— Experience in a multi-location family medicine or primary care environment

— Familiarity with payer-specific rules for Medicare, Medicaid, and TRICARE

— Background in prior authorization and referral coordination workflows

— Experience managing the full billing cycle independently with minimal oversight

— Clinical background (nursing, medical assisting) is a meaningful advantage



Our Insurance Partners

You will be working across our full carrier network on a daily basis: Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Humana, TRICARE, Medicare, and Medicaid. Familiarity with payer-specific billing requirements for each is a strong advantage.



Critical Policies

— Exclusivity while on the clock -- during paid working hours, you support Mercy Wellness only

— Strict HIPAA compliance -- no PHI stored locally, no unauthorized sharing, no exceptions

— Confidentiality agreement required -- signed prior to start date



What We Offer

— Fully remote, full-time position with consistent Central Time hours

— Two openings -- both will be filled from this posting

— Direct impact on clinic operations and patient care continuity across two locations

— A role that blends billing expertise with meaningful clinical contribution

— US Federal holidays plus 4 additional cultural holidays

— Paid training and performance-based growth opportunities

— Competitive monthly compensation 



HOW TO APPLY -- REQUIRED SUBMISSIONS

Submit all three items below. Applications missing any of the following will not be reviewed.

— Resume in PDF format -- include specific billing experience, EMR platforms used, and any clinical support background

— 2-3 minute introduction video via Loom or Google Drive -- introduce yourself, walk us through your billing experience and — — Athena Health proficiency, and highlight a specific example of resolving a complex claim or denial



Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagWFW91EJQpT08fw/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.

JOB DESCRIPTION



We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist to lead the creation of AI-generated product imagery, lifestyle scenes, and short-form video for our brands, including HiEnd Accents and Paseo Road. You'll take our products from a flat studio shot to fully-realized lifestyle photography and video creative used across our website, paid social ads,
 campaigns, and Pinterest. You'll own the full pipeline: writing prompts, generating images and videos with tools like Gemini (Nano Banana Pro), Midjourney, Kling, and Veo, finishing them in Photoshop/Canva if needed, and assembling them into finished ad creatives.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Generate photorealistic lifestyle product photography using AI image tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, or similar), placing our bedding, pillows, rugs, and home textiles into believable room scenes, on-model shots, and editorial-style compositions



- Animate hero images into short-form video using Kling, Veo 3/3.1, or comparable image-to-video tools for use in Meta ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and on-site PDP video



- Write, test, and continuously refine your own prompts, building reusable prompt templates and a library of looks that maintain visual consistency across each brand



- Build finished static and video ad creatives (Meta, Pinterest, Google) by combining AI-generated imagery with on-brand text overlays, logos, and sizing variants



- Finish and retouch every AI output in Photoshop, Canva, and/or Lightroom, fixing hands, edges, lighting, fabric texture, and any AI artifacts before delivery so nothing leaves your hands looking AI-generated



- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via
, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week



- Commitment to the company's mission and values, which can be found here: 



- Excel as a team player, contributing positively to our collective success.





ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS



HiEnd Accents designs and sells premium bedding and home textiles (quilts, sheets, decorative pillows, duvets, and more) that bring everyday luxury into people's homes. We've been family-owned and operated since 2005, now in our second generation of leadership, and are headquartered in Dallas, Texas.



We serve thousands of retailers, interior designers, department stores, and boutique hotels across the United States through four distinct brands spanning a range of styles and price points. Our growth has been recognized nationally: we've been named to the Inc. 5000 (a prestigious list of America's fastest-growing private companies) two years running, and have received multiple industry awards for product excellence.



We're a company of around 45 people, small enough that every person matters, established enough that you're joining something real and growing.



Discover more at 
.





WHY HIEND ACCENTS?



We're growing our team in the Philippines because we believe in finding the best people regardless of geography, and investing in them for the long term.



As a family-owned company, we don't treat our tea
mbers as interchangeable. We take the time to build real working relationships, we care about your professional development, and we want every person who works with us to leave with stronger skills than when they started. That's a genuine commitment from our leadership, not a line in a job posting.



What you can expect:



You'll work directly with our core team in Texas, not through layers of management or a BPO intermediary. Your contributions will be visible, your ideas heard, and your growth supported.



- Compensation & Benefits: Competitive pay benchmarked to PH market rates for skilled roles, not entry-level floors. Paid time off including vacation days and holidays, plus 13th-month pay.

We're a small, growing team that already works with a great group of Filipino editors and support staff, and we're looking to add a reliable bookkeeper to keep our finances clean and organized.



We value people who are thorough, communicative, and in this for the long haul. If you do good work, this role grows with us.



## What You'll Do



- Do an initial pass to get books caught up and on track

- Categorize and reconcile transactions in our accounting software (QuickBooks Online)

- Reconcile bank accounts monthly

- Track income and expenses, including payments to our contractors and editors

- Maintain a clean, organized chart of accounts

- Prepare simple monthly financial reports (P&L, expense summaries)

- Flag anything unusual or anything you need clarification on

- Keep our books year-round so they're tax-ready for our U.S. CPA at filing time



## What We're Looking For



- Solid bookkeeping experience, ideally with U.S.-based small business clients

- Comfortable and certified (or experienced) with QuickBooks Online and/or Xero

- Understands U.S. small business bookkeeping basics

- Detail-oriented and reliable with a consistent weekly schedule

- Good written English and responsive communication

- Treats client financial data with care and confidentiality

- Works directly in the accounting software (not loose spreadsheets passed back and forth)



Bonus if you have:



- Experience with service-based or media/creative businesses

- Experience working with U.S. CPAs at tax time



## The Arrangement



- **Independent contractor role.** You invoice us; you manage your own taxes locally.

- **Reliable weekly hours** with flexibility on when you work them — we care about the work being done well, not clocking specific minutes.

- **Long-term focus.** We'd much rather find one great person and keep them for years than rotate through people.

- **Room to grow.** As the company grows, there's a clear path to more hours and more responsibility for the right person. We pay well for people who make our lives easier.

- **Paid trial month.** First month is a paid working trial so we both make sure it's a good fit.



## Compensation



Competitive rate based on your experience — please include your monthly or hourly rate expectation in your application. We're not looking for the cheapest option; we're looking for someone genuinely good who we can rely on and keep long-term.



## How to Apply



To show us you've read this carefully, please begin your application with the word "Ledger" so we know you're paying attention.



Please send:



1. A short intro about yourself and your bookkeeping experience

2. The accounting software you're most comfortable with and any certifications

3. Whether you've worked with U.S.-based clients before

4. Your rate expectation

5. Your general availability



Applications that answer all five points will be prioritized. We read every application and will respond to candidates we'd like to talk to further.



We look forward to meeting you.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Odoo (Python)
description:
About BluIP 



BluIP is a US-based managed communications and cloud services provider serving enterprise customers across hospitality, healthcare, and multi-location retail. We are executing a multi-year ERP transformation that consolidates CRM, sales, subscriptions, telecom billing, accounting, support, commissions, and partner operations onto Odoo Enterprise 19. The platform handles real telecom rating workloads, multi-company partner hierarchies, and integrations with carriers, tax engines, and BroadSoft provisioning. 



About the role 



You will be the senior technical anchor for the BluIP Odoo build out of our Manila office. You will own architecture-level decisions, lead a small team of two to three Odoo developers, and pair directly with the program lead to ship phases of our roadmap. You will write production code, review every pull request from your team, and mentor junior engineers. This is a hands-on senior IC role with team lead responsibilities, not a manager-only position. 



How we work: AI-assisted engineering 



BluIP engineering is an AI-first practice. We expect at least 75 percent of code shipped by every engineer on this team to be written with an AI coding assistant, with a strong preference for Claude (Claude Code, Claude in IDE, or the Claude Agent SDK). The role of a developer here is not to type code from scratch but to direct AI tooling well: write tight prompts, review every diff, validate against the live branch, run the test suite, and own the result. We measure quality on shipped outcomes, code review pass rate, test coverage, and adherence to project rules, not on whether the keystrokes were yours. 



If you are skeptical of AI-assisted development, this is not the right team. If you are fluent with Claude or comparable assistants, can break down a phase into AI-shippable stages, and can catch when the model is wrong, you will thrive. 



What you will do 



Own delivery of phases on the BluIT codebase (custom modules on top of Odoo Enterprise 19) running on Odoo.sh. 



Lead, mentor, and review work from two to three developers based in Manila. 



Pair with the program lead on phase planning, audit cycles, stage gates, and reconciliation work. 



Build and extend custom modules across telecom rating, billing, subscriptions, provisioning, tax, and reporting. 



Drive 75 percent or more of code output through AI coding assistants (Claude preferred), and coach the developer team on the same standard. 



Enforce the BluIT project rules: multi-company guards, decimal money math, ISO
CDR encoding, savepoint patterns on hot-path creates, live mode off by default on external adapters. 



Write rigorous tests covering multi-company isolation, cron time budget, race conditions, encoding round trip, and live mode safety. 



Integrate with external systems including BroadSoft, CereTax, payment providers, carriers, and E911 gateways. 



Drive parallel-run reconciliation work as we cut over from the legacy LogiSense platform. 



Required qualifications 



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 



6+ years of professional Python development. 



3+ years building production Odoo modules, ideally Enterprise (Odoo 15 through 19). 



Demonstrated fluency with AI coding assistants (Claude Code strongly preferred; Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar acceptable). You are comfortable shipping the majority of your code through an AI assistant and you can show examples. 



Deep ORM experience: models, fields, inheritance, security, record rules, multi-company patterns. 



Proficient with Odoo views (XML), security CSV and record rules, data modules, and scheduled actions. 



Hands-on experience writing and maintaining Odoo test suites (TransactionCase, HttpCase). 



Strong PostgreSQL: query optimization, indexing, partitioning, advisory locks. 



Comfortable in a Git-based workflow with branching, code review, and continuous deployment. 



Excellent written and verbal English communication. 



Preferred qualifications 



Production experience using Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, or the Anthropic API in a real codebase. 



Experience with Odoo Enterprise multi-company architecture at scale. 



Subscription billing, recurring invoicing, or usage-based billing experience. 



Telecom domain experience: CDR processing, rating engines, mediation, tax compliance, provisioning. 



Experience with Odoo.sh hosting, including CI/CD, environment promotion, and cron constraints. 



Familiarity with telecom integrations: BroadSoft and BroadWorks, SureTax or CereTax, SIP carriers. 



Prior experience leading or mentoring a small engineering team. 



Background in financial systems, accounting modules, or ERP at scale. 



What we offer 



Competitive Philippine salary aligned with the senior engineering bracket at BluIP. 



Permanent role at BluIP Philippines (Manila office). 



Health insurance and standard BluIP PH benefits. 



Direct working relationship with the US-based program lead. 



Company-funded AI tooling: Claude (Code, IDE, API), and the budget to use them at full capacity. 



Ownership of a flagship internal platform with multi-year roadmap visibility. 



Career path into staff engineer or engineering management as the team scales. 



How to apply 



Send your CV, GitHub or code samples, and a short note describing: (1) a hard Odoo problem you have shipped, and (2) how you currently use an AI coding assistant in your day-to-day engineering work.
 
 & 
 with the subject line: Senior Odoo Developer, Manila. 



BluIP is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Inbound Sales Rep & Setter (SDR) - High-Ticket Funnel Agency | GoFunnels
description:
Exciting opportunity to work with Maazin and his team at GoFunnels 



WHO WE ARE



GoFunnels is a done-for-you funnel building and revenue infrastructure firm. We've built over 2,000 funnels and optimized 1,000+ GoHighLevel accounts for clients including Gym Launch, Brian Tracy, and Valuetainment.

We don't build pretty websites. We build backend systems that generate revenue. Our clients are founders doing $10K to $500K+ per month who need their marketing and sales infrastructure to actually work.





THE ROLE



You'll be the first point of contact for every prospect who applies to work with us. Your job is to make sure every call on our Head of Sales' calendar is qualified, prepared, and ready to close.

This is not a cold-calling role. Our leads come inbound fro
ta ads and Instagram. They've already raised their hand. Your job is to take that hand-raise and turn it into a high-quality Discovery call.

You'll report directly to our Head of Sales. The communication between you two needs to be tight. Daily sync meetings. You'll be his right hand in the sales process.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO EVERY DAY



1) Manage inbound applications. Prospects come through our typeform after seeing our ads. Some book calls. Some don't. Your job is to work both lists:



2) For prospects who book: Call or message them to confirm, make sure they've watched the pre-call video, qualify them before the call, and reschedule or disqualify if they're not a fit.

For prospects who don't book: Call them, find out where they dropped off, and get them scheduled.



Speed matters. When a hot application comes in, you need to be on it within minutes. Not hours. The faster you reach a prospect after they apply, the higher the show rate and the better the call quality.

Work lead lists. We have existing lead lists that need to be worked. Your job is to go through them, re-engage prospects, and get qualified ones onto calls.



Manage Instagram DMs. You'll be managing conversations on the founder's Instagram account. Prospects reach out through DMs, comments, and stories. You'll follow up on those conversations and route qualified prospects toward booking a call.

Qualify with judgment, not just a script. You need to know the difference between a founder who's genuinely ready to invest in their infrastructure and someone who's "just looking." Calendar space is valuable. Every call you book should be one he can close. If you flood him with weak calls, that's a problem. If you're too aggressive disqualifying, that's also a problem. The judgment to get this right is the most important skill in this role.



Fill out disposition forms. When you take action on a lead, you log it. Simple form, three fields. This keeps the pipeline clean and gives us data to optimize.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Someone who gets the agency and marketing world. You don't need to be a funnel expert. But when a prospect mentions GHL, ad spend, funnels, automations, or lead gen, you shouldn't sound lost. If you've worked in or around digital marketing, agencies, or SaaS for a year or two, you'll be fine.

Strong written communication. Half your outreach is SMS,
, and DMs. Your writing needs to sound like a real human being, not a template. Direct, confident, no fluff. If your natural writing style is corporate jargon or overly formal, this isn't the right fit.



Excellent English with American accent. Our clients are American founders and business owners. You'll be calling and texting them daily. Your English needs to be fluent, natural, and easy to understand on the first listen. An American-leaning accent is required. If a prospect has to ask you to repeat yourself, the call is already going sideways. This is non-negotiable.

Phone presence that builds trust quickly. When you get a prospect on the phone, you have about 90 seconds to sound competent and warm. You're not closing. You're earning the right to book them with our Head of Sales. That takes a specific kind of confidence.



Proactive and intrapreneurial. Our systems are not fully built out. We're building as we go. We don't want someone who sits around waiting for SOPs and instructions. We want someone who sees a gap, brings an idea, and says "I think we should try this." If you've used AI tools to improve your own workflows, that's a strong signal. If you think like an operator and not just an employee, you'll thrive here.



Comfortable with fast-paced, Slack-driven work. Your day is reactive. Alerts come in, you respond fast, you manage multiple conversations simultaneously. If you need a quiet, structured, one-thing-at-a-time environment, this will feel chaotic. If you thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities shift throughout the day, you'll love it.



Resilience without ego. Prospects will ghost you. Some will be rude. You need to bounce back fast without taking it personally. But you also need emotional intelligence to read when to push and when to back off. Empathy without softness.





WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR



Script-dependent SDRs. If you need a word-for-word script to function, this role will break you. You need to think on your feet and adapt to each conversation.



High-volume cold-call veterans. Our leads are inbound. The skill set is different. We need someone who can warm-engage people who've already shown interest, not hammer through a cold list.

People who just want to hit quota and clock out. We're building something. The right person sees this as a launchpad, not a job. If you want to grow into a closer role within 12-18 months, this is your path. If you just want to collect a paycheck, we're not a fit.



Over-promisers. The smooth talker who sounds great in interviews but sets wrong expectations with prospects. We sell through clarity and proof, not pressure. Your tone should match that.





COMPENSATION



Base: $1,200/month starting (90-day review to $1,500 based on performance)

Commission: 1.5% of closed deal value from calls you book

Monthly milestone bonuses:

$50K cash collected in a month: $100 bonus

$100K cash collected in a month: $250 bonus



Milestones reset monthly. Commission is tied to deals that actually close, not bookings. This means your incentive is to book quality, not volume.



What this looks like in practice:

- You book 75 calls, 20 close, cash collected is $150K

- You get $1,200 base + $2,250 (1.5% of cash collected) + $350 ($50K + $100K cash collected bonus)

- Total: $3,800



90-day review criteria for base increase:



- Speed-to-lead consistency (85%+ SLA hit rate)

- Show-up rate on booked calls (70%+)

- Disposition form completion (100%)

-Head of Sales' assessment of call quality





HOURS AND SCHEDULE



You'll be working US business hours. From the Philippines, that means night shift (roughly 9pm-6am Manila time). If you've done this before, you know the drill. If you haven't, be honest with yourself about whether you can sustain it. The speed-to-lead requirement means you need to be fully alert and responsive during peak hours.





HOW TO APPLY



Step 1: Send your resume and a short Loom video (under 90 seconds) on why this role interests you.



Step 2: Answer this in your application: "A prospect fills out our application form. You call them. They don't pick up. Two hours later they text back: 'Hey sorry I missed your call, what's this about?' Write your reply."

Don't overthink it. Just write what you'd actually send. We're looking at how you communicate, not whether you hit some magic formula.



Step 3: Record a 60-second voice note (phone recording or voice memo is fine) introducing yourself and telling us about a time you turned an unresponsive lead into a booked meeting. Upload it or share a link. This is how we assess your spoken English and communication style. Applications without a voice note will not be reviewed.



Step 4: If we like what we see and hear, you'll have a short interview with our Head of Sales followed by a conversation with our founder.



We're hiring one person for this role. If you're the right fit, you'll know it and so will we.



Best,

Maazin

Founder of GoFunnels

description:
Full-Time Position | Rich&Co | Auckland 



Rich&Co is a well-established creative agency specialising in branding, WordPress websites, and digital design solutions for businesses across New Zealand and Australia. We are looking for an experienced and highly capable WordPress Developer to join our team on a full-time basis.



This is not a basic website production role. We are seeking someone who understands the complete ecosystem of modern web development — from frontend performance and responsive UX through to hosting infrastructure, security, SEO, marketing integrations, and conversion-focused implementation.



You will work closely alongside an experienced creative and strategic team, helping deliver bespoke, high-performing websites primarily built in WordPress and WooCommerce.

description:

(1) Location & Utilities: Where in the Philippines are you currently located? How often have you experienced power or internet outages in the past year? Do you have backup solutions (e.g., generator, mobile hotspot) to ensure your work is not affected?



(2) Home Setup: Will you be working from home? Is your workspace quiet and suitable for handling calls? Do you have your own computer or laptop? Please attach a screenshot of your current internet speed.



(3) Availability & Speed: Can you consistently work seven days a week, six hours per day, and remain available for the full shift without missed calls? How quickly do you typically answer inbound calls? What is your current typing speed in words per minute?



(4) Call & Complaint Experience: Describe your experience with answering inbound calls, booking or scheduling appointments, customer service, following scripts, and handling complaints. Provide one real example of how you de-escalated an upset client and the outcome.



(5) Tools & Systems: What programs, tools, phone systems, or VoIP platforms have you used for handling calls? Do you have any issues with background noise, power outages, or internet interruptions? How do you take notes and log client interactions during calls?



(6) Voice Recordings: Please submit two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund. Your tone should be calm, polite, and professional.



(7) Current Job: Do you currently have another job? If yes, where, how many hours per week, and what are your roles and tasks in that job?



(8) Schedule, Pay & Start Date: Are you able to work seven days a week, six hours per day, during Central Standard Time (CST) hours without conflicts? What is your expected hourly or monthly rate? What is your earliest physical start date if hired?

 Reels or similar platforms? Please describe your skills and provide samples of your previous work if available.

description:
About Lekker Studios

Lekker Studios is a luxury architectural and real estate photography and media company based in New Jersey, USA. We serve high-end real estate agents, developers, and architects across the NYC metro area. Our work includes photography, cinematic video, social media content, iGUIDE 3D tours, and brand marketing.

We are a small, fast-moving team. Every person on it carries real weight. We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are looking for someone who will own their role, think ahead, and execute without being managed every step of the way.



THIS IS NOT A PASSIVE ROLE.

If your working style is to wait for instructions before you move, this is not the right fit.

If your working style is to hit a wall on a task, try a different approach, figure it out, and report back with results — keep reading.



What You Will Do



Manage and publish daily social media content for Instagram and
 — on time, on brand, no reminders needed

Build and maintain a structured content calendar every week

Design graphics, Reels, and Stories that match a luxury brand standard

Use Claude AI (Cowork and Code) to draft copy, build workflows, support client communications, and handle research tasks

Use Higgsfield AI to produce and iterate on cinematic video content for listings, social, and brand campaigns

Execute SEO-optimized content strategies

Organize media files after every shoot — clean, labeled, and searchable every time

Set up and maintain automation in Zoho CRM and connected tools

Handle light admin:
 coordination, project tracking, vendor follow-up

Identify workflow gaps and bring forward solutions, not just observations





AI Tools — This Is a Hard Requirement

You must have real, hands-on experience with:



Claude AI — Cowork and Code. You use it daily. You know how to build prompts that produce actual results, not just generic output.

Higgsfield AI — You have used it or are actively learning it. Cinematic video generation, model selection, media upload, and brand-quality output.

AI workflow design — You connect tools, automate sequences, and think about how AI serves a bigger goal. Not just single prompts.



Other tools that matter: ChatGPT, Canva, Midjourney or Adobe Firefly, Runway or Kling — any hands-on AI tool experience is a plus.



Technical Skills Required



Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, DaVinci Resolve (color grading experience is a strong bonus)

WordPress management

Zoho CRM or similar CRM tools

Slack

Asana, Trello, or Notion (any task management platform)

Strong grasp of Instagram,
, and YouTube Shorts content strategy





Who You Are



You do not need to be micromanaged. You run toward problems.

You think about outcomes, not just tasks. You ask what this is supposed to accomplish.

When something doesn't work, you pivot, document why, and try the next approach.

You are detail-oriented and consistent. Quality does not fluctuate based on how your week is going.

You communicate clearly and proactively. You surface blockers early. You close the loop without being asked.

You are genuinely curious about AI tools and what is changing. Not a passive user — someone who tests, learns, and brings ideas forward.





Job Details



Part-time to start: Monday to Friday, 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST (New York time)

Strong potential to grow to full-time (8 hours/day) based on performance

Remote — open to Filipino applicants who can commit to EST hours

Long-term role — we are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



How to Apply

Do not send a template application. Read this post. Then send three things:



Your resume — current and honest

A brief portfolio — social posts, video edits, graphics, AI-assisted projects, or any workflow system you have built. Show the actual work.

A short note — 200 to 300 words answering this: Tell us about a time a task hit a wall. What did you try first? What did you do when it didn't work? What was the outcome?



Here's the exact language to drop into the post. Two versions — pick one or blend them.



Before we review your resume or portfolio, we want to meet you first.

Record a short video — 60 to 90 seconds, nothing fancy. Just you, on camera, speaking clearly. Tell us:

1. Your name and where you are based

2. The AI tools you use regularly — specifically Claude AI and Higgsfield — and what you have actually done with them

3. One piece of work you are proud of and why

Upload it to YouTube (unlisted is fine), Google Drive, or Loom and include the link in your application. No link, no review.

We are not judging your camera setup. We are listening for how you think, how you communicate, and whether you are the kind of person who steps up when given a task.



Applications without the short note will not be reviewed.

title: Paid Media Specialist - Meta Ads + Google Ads
description:
About Streamline Property Buyers



Streamline Property Buyers is a Brisbane-based buyers agency - we work exclusively for property buyers, helping investors and home buyers navigate Brisbane's property market with expert guidance, independent research, and professional negotiation.



We are led by Melinda Jennison, Queensland's most awarded buyers agent: REIQ Buyers Agent of the Year 2022, 2023 and 2024, inducted into the REIQ Hall of Fame in 2025, and President of the Real Estate Buyers Agents Association of Australia.

We have invested significant time building a complete digital marketing infrastructure - lead magnets, landing pages, ad creative,
 nurture sequences, and Zoho One integration. We are ready to launch. We now need the right person to set up, manage, and optimise the paid media campaigns that will drive traffic into that system.



You will join a team of specialists that we already employ in Philippines - you will become part of our Streamline work family!



About This Role



This is a paid media specialist role. We need someone who can take our existing marketing assets and build the infrastructure to run campaigns on Meta 
 and Instagram) and Google Ads - managing everything from initial setup through to ongoing optimisation and weekly reporting.



This is not a virtual assistant role. We are looking for a genuine paid media specialist with hands-on campaign management experience, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to work independently with minimal hand-holding.



To be clear about the division of responsibilities:



WE HANDLE (already done or in-house)

?  Lead magnet PDF guides (both being created)

?  Landing pages (built, ready to publish)

?  Ad copy - all written (static + video scripts)

?  Static image creative (designed in-house)

? 
 nurture sequences (Zoho Campaigns)

?  CRM setup (Zoho One)

?  Video creative (filmed in-house by our team) 



YOU OWN (the role we're hiring for)

?  Meta Business Manager setup and configuration

?  Meta Pixel installation + Lead event tracking

?  Campaign build - ad sets, audiences, placements

?  Google Ads account setup + Search campaigns

?  Google Tag Manager + conversion tracking

?  Ongoing campaign optimisation + A/B testing

?  Weekly performance reporting in plain language



What You'll Be Responsible For



Phase 1 — Setup (first 2–4 weeks)



– Set up and configure Meta Business Manager, Ad Account, and
/Instagram pages if required

– Install Meta Pixel on our website and verify Lead conversion event fires correctly on thank you pages

– Upload custom audience (past client list) and build Lookalike Audiences for both investor and home buyer segments

– Build both ad sets from our existing copy and creative assets — investor audience and home buyer audience

– Set up Google Ads account, configure billing, and build initial Search campaigns targeting Brisbane buyers agent and 

related terms

– Install Google Tag Manager and configure conversion tracking for form completions and call bookings

– Configure UTM parameters across all campaign URLs for accurate attribution in Zoho CRM

– Run a pre-launch checklist and confirm all tracking is verified before campaigns go live



Phase 2 — Ongoing Management (weekly)



– Monitor campaign performance daily — spend, CPL, CTR, conversion rate, ROAS

– Optimise ad sets: pause underperforming creatives, scale what is working, adjust bids and budgets

– Test audience variants and creative combinations systematically — one variable at a time

– Manage retargeting audiences: page visitors, guide downloaders, high
 engagement segments

– Review Google Ads search term reports weekly — add negative keywords, identify new opportunities

– Deliver a weekly performance report every Monday — plain language summary with key metrics, observations, and recommended actions for the following week

– Flag budget overspend risks and creative fatigue proactively — do not wait for us to ask



What We're Looking For



Non-negotiable requirements:



?  Proven Meta Ads experience  — at least 2 years managing
/Instagram campaigns with demonstrable results

?  Google Ads experience  — Search campaigns, conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager

?  Lead generation focus  — experience running campaigns specifically to generate leads, not just traffic or engagement

?  Strong analytical skills  — comfortable reading campaign data, identifying what's working and what isn't, and acting on it

?  Clear written communication  — able to write weekly reports our team can understand without a digital marketing background

?  Self-directed  — able to manage priorities independently and flag issues proactively without needing daily oversight



Highly valued but not essential:



– Experience in the real estate, property, or financial services industry

– Familiarity with Zoho One, Zoho CRM, or Zoho Campaigns

– Experience with audience segmentation for two distinct buyer types

– Google Analytics 4 setup and reporting

– Experience working with Australian clients or the Australian market



This role is not right for you if:



?  You specialise primarily in social media management, content creation, or organic growth - this is a paid media role

?  You are looking for a role where you will be given detailed instructions on what to do each week

?  You are not able to clearly explain campaign performance and recommendations in plain language

?  You do not have experience with lead generation campaigns - brand awareness is not what we need



About This Opportunity



Why this role is worth applying for ...



Everything is built and ready to go.



You're not being hired to build a marketing strategy from scratch. The lead magnets are written. The landing pages are built. The ad copy is done. The
 sequences are in Zoho Campaigns. The CRM is configured. We've done the foundational work - we need the right person to build the paid media infrastructure around it and manage it ongoing.



This is an opportunity to work with a well-regarded, award-winning professional services business that values expertise, clear communication, and long-term working relationships. If you deliver results, this role grows with us.



Working With Us



We are a small, professional team based in Brisbane, Australia. Melinda will be your primary point of contact for this role.

We are not a marketing agency - we are a specialist property advisory firm. We know our business and our clients exceptionally well, and we have invested significantly in building quality marketing assets. Opportunity to grow with the label

2–5 examples of content you’ve created

)!



If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



Job Description

The Accounts Receivable Coordinator is responsible for managing the end-to-end receivables process at Wonderist Agency across both operating entities. This includes generating and sending client invoices, monitoring payment status, following up on outstanding balances, and reconciling payments in the accounting system. This role works closely with the accounting team and executive suite and reports directly to the Finance Operations Manager



Key Responsibilities

Weekly

Generate and distribute client invoices for active accounts across both entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing)

Monitor payment receipt and update the AR ledger in the accounting system

Follow up on outstanding invoices via
 and phone according to collections cadence

Record and apply incoming payments, credits, and adjustments accurately

Flag any disputed invoices or non-payment risks to the Finance team.

Attend weekly finance check-in with leadership; come prepared with a current AR snapshot including outstanding balances, collections activity, aged items, and any client billing escalations requiring a decision

Monthly

Prepare and distribute the monthly AR aging report

Conduct a full reconciliation of client payments against invoiced amounts

Escalate unresolved collections issues with clear documentation and recommended next steps

Support month-end close by delivering complete and accurate AR data on schedule

Maintain organized records of all invoices, payment confirmations, and client correspondence

Quarterly/As Needed

Assist with audit preparation by compiling AR documentation as requested

Identify patterns in late payments and recommend adjustments to billing or collections processes

Support client account reconciliation requests and statement generation

Participate in process improvement initiatives related to finance operations

Performance Metrics

Invoice accuracy and on-time delivery (target: 100?ch billing cycle)

AR aging performance (target: less than 10% of balances aged beyond 30 days)

Collections follow-through rate and documentation quality

On-time delivery of monthly AR aging report

Completeness and accuracy of records for month-end close



Essential Functions: What You’ll Do

Invoice Processing and Payment Execution: Generate accurate, timely invoices for all active client accounts. Ensure invoices reflect current service packages, pricing, and entity assignment. Send invoices through the appropriate channel and confirm receipt when needed.

Collections and Follow-Up: Execute a consistent collections cadence for outstanding balances. Communicate professionally with clients to resolve payment delays while preserving the client relationship. Escalate persistent non-payment issues with clear documentation and recommended action. Client-facing communication on billing disputes routes through the HR and Finance Specialist or leadership; the AR Coordinator is responsible for flagging, documenting, and preparing context for escalation rather than owning direct client resolution independently.

Client Billing Documentation: Maintain account-level billing notes for clients with complex histories, special billing arrangements, or ongoing disputes. Ensure institutional knowledge is documented so context is accessible during transitions or escalations and does not rely on individual memory.

Payment Reconciliation: Apply all incoming payments accurately to client accounts in the accounting system. Investigate and resolve discrepancies between invoiced amounts and payments received. Ensure credits, adjustments, and write-offs are processed with proper approvals.

AR Reporting: Maintain a current and accurate AR aging report. Deliver monthly reporting to the HR and Finance Specialist and leadership on time. Provide clear visibility into outstanding balances, collections risk, and month-over-month trends.

Cross-Entity Coordination: Manage receivables across both operating entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing), ensuring accurate entity coding and clear separation of client records.

Inter-Entity Transactions: Support accurate coding and reconciliation of any shared costs or allocated expenses across Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing, maintaining clear separation of records between entities.



Core Competencies: What you’ll bring to the role

Attention to Detail: You verify invoice accuracy before sending, apply payments to the correct accounts, and catch discrepancies before they compound. Precision is non-negotiable in this role.

Professional Communication: You follow up on outstanding invoices with confidence and professionalism. You can hold a firm position on payment timelines without damaging client relationships. Your written communication is clear, polished, and free of ambiguity.

Organization and Prioritization: You manage a high volume of client accounts simultaneously and know how to triage collections activity by urgency and risk. You maintain complete records without being asked.

Systems Proficiency: You are comfortable working in accounting software and picking up new platforms quickly. Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, or similar tools is required. Familiarity with Rippling Spend, 
, or similar platforms is a plus

Integrity and Discretion: You handle sensitive client account information with professionalism and confidentiality. You operate with consistency and honesty in all financial record keeping.



Must-Have Qualifications

2+ years of accounts receivable, billing, or bookkeeping experience

Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar

Strong command of written English for client and internal communication

Experience with collections follow-up and comfortable having direct conversations about payment timelines

High attention to detail and ability to manage a large volume of client accounts accurately

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with minimal supervision

Reliable internet connection and ability to work during Pacific Time business hours (partial overlap required)

Payment application authority will be granted by leadership up to an approved threshold; comfort applying payments and initiating adjustments within those parameters is required



Bonus Points for Applicants With…

(if you don’t have these but are organized and want to learn, we want to hear from you!)

Familiarity with Rippling, Stripe, HubSpot billing, or similar platforms

Background in agency, marketing, or professional services environments

Experience supporting multi-entity accounting operations

     * Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with IT and vendors to set up conversion goals, experiments, and backend analytics for omni-channel marketing campaigns.



CRM & Website Management

     * CRM Administration: Manage lead flows and reporting within Salesforce and HubSpot, ensuring seamless integration,data integrity, and lead-scoring accuracy. 

     * Website (CMS): Maintain and update the company website via WordPress, ensuring blog posts, landing pages, and team bios are current and SEO-optimized.

     * Lead Gen: Build high-converting landing pages and manage contact lists for automated
 nurturing workflows and customer journeys.

     * AI Content Scaling: Use generative AI to help scale content generation while maintaining brand standards and SEO best practices.



Advocacy & Support

     * Team Support: Provide general administrative support, including meeting scheduling and ad-hoc growth tasks.

     * Continuous Learning: Stay current on the latest digital marketing tools, research methods, and industry best practices.



Qualifications

     * AI Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of generative AI tools (like Google Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) to analyze data, automate workflows, and scale content.

     * Marketing & Tech Tools: Proficiency in Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and WordPress.

     * Technical Skills: Mastery of Excel/Google Sheets (Pivot tables, data visualization) and deep understanding of UTM tracking logic.



Core Competencies

     * Analytical Instinct: A keen ability to "read between the lines" in data and interpret early signals (“reading the tea leaves”) to anticipate emerging trends. You can spot shifts before they fully manifest in the metrics.

     * Strong Attention to Detail: An elite ability to catch errors, proofread materials, and ensure 100?curacy in all marketing and data outputs.

     * Proactive & Initiative-Taking: A natural willingness to anticipate needs and identify potential process improvements before being asked.

     * Adaptability & Problem Solving: Flexibility to quickly shift priorities and manage multiple tasks efficiently in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

     * Effective Communication: Ability to clearly articulate ideas and collaborate effectively with tea
mbers to ensure total alignment.

     * Organizational Skills: Excellent time management and organization to keep complex projects on track and ensure every deadline is met.



Action Items:

Interested candidates should submit a resume, an intro video, and a brief cover note describing their experience managing technical infrastructure in a remote environment.



Why Join Falcon Wealth Planning?



Growth Potential: As a junior-to-mid-level hire, you will have a front-row seat to how a successful RIA scales.

Creative Freedom: We value fresh ideas and "out of the box" thinking to make finance more accessible.

Collaborative Culture: Work with a team that values transparency and professional development.
